title: Creative Marketing Specialist — Content, Video, Social & CRM
description:
This is a part-time role designed to grow

We are looking for someone to take ownership of our content, video and social presence, and to support the marketing systems sitting behind it.



It starts at two days a week. For the right person the opportunity is considerably bigger than that — our intention is to grow the role alongside the person: more days, more scope, and in time the paid advertising we currently send outside. That progression is d
 by what you produce, not by how long you have been here.



What the role actually is

The larger part is content — video editing, graphic design and social media management. Turning raw footage shot on a phone on a building site, with no script and no shot list, into short-form video people stop scrolling for. Building the graphics and client-facing material around it, and running the calendar across Instagram,
 and 
. There is also the chance to work with professionally shot photography and video, and to put your own flair and style through our socials and website.



The rest is the machinery behind it — our CRM, our website, our search presence, and the numbers that tell us whether any of it is working. We want both halves in one person. It is a genuinely hard combination to find, which is why we are being specific rather than hoping.



The content side

- Turning raw site footage into finished Reels — walkthroughs, before-and-afters, progress, behind the scenes, the trades at work

- Cutting talking-head video with our director into something watchable

- Editing and colour-correcting project photography

- Carousels, branded graphics, marketing one-pagers, and the client-facing PDFs and information packs we send through pre-construction

- Repurposing long-form material — blogs, videos, site notes — into social-ready pieces

- Running and improving our content calendar across Instagram,
 and 

- Working with our site team to pull out the moments worth filming, and telling them what you need from them

- Watching what performs and telling us what you would change

- Bringing us ideas we did not ask for



The systems side

- Working in our CRM — pipelines, opportunities, forms, custom fields

- Supporting workflows and automations,
 and SMS campaigns

- Making sure enquiries are captured properly and followed through

- Blog uploads and page updates on our website, with half an eye on how they are structured for search

- Tracking what actually produces enquiries, not just impressions



We use GoHighLevel. Hands-on GHL experience is a real advantage and we want to hear about it in detail. Comparable CRM experience — HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, Zoho — plus a genuine ability to learn systems works too. Over time we want to bring more of our paid advertising in-house, so if you understand how ads, search and analytics fit together, that is where this role has the most room to grow



How we think about AI

We use AI here every day and we expect you to. Being good with it is a skill we value.



What we are hiring is your judgement — the pacing of a cut, the hook in the first two seconds, the reason one shot follows another, the voice in a caption. Our homes are custom and our content should feel the same way: recognisably ours.



If you can point at a real piece of your own work and tell us exactly where the model helped and where you took over, you are the sort of person we want to talk to.



Who this suits

You will not be expected to work it all out alone. You will have plenty of support while you learn our business, our brand and the way we work, and we expect questions during onboarding — we collaborate closely as a team.



As you settle in we will expect you to take increasing ownership of your work. The people who do well with us bring solutions rather than questions, flag issues early rather than on the deadline, take feedback well and go around again to hit the standard, and genuinely care about what they put their name to. Every so often they send us something nobody asked for that turns out to be exactly what we needed.



If you want to be told exactly what to do each morning, this will frustrate you. If you have been looking for somewhere that gives you real ownership and rewards it, this is that.



What you need

- Around three years of hands-on content creation experience — where video, design and social content have been a meaningful part of your actual role. If you have less but a portfolio that speaks for itself, apply anyway

- Strong short-form vertical video editing — building an edit from raw, unsorted footage rather than working from a template

- Confidence in CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve — whichever is genuinely yours, and tell us which

- Strong Canva skills and the discipline to hold an existing brand kit

- Real hands-on confidence inside a CRM, ideally GoHighLevel

- Fluency with AI tools, and the judgement to keep the creative decisions your own

- Excellent written and spoken English

- The ability to work two days a week without being chased, and to say early when

something will not be ready



Helpful, not essential: construction, architecture or property experience · Google Ads or Meta Ads · SEO fundamentals and Google Analytics · WordPress · Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign · LinkedIn content



How to apply

One honest note first. We know some people will paste this ad into an AI tool and send back whatever comes out. We are not against you using AI to help you write — we use it every day ourselves. But we can tell the difference between an application written with help and one where nobody was really there, and we only want to hear from people who actually want this particular job at this particular company.



Two of the things below cannot be produced by a tool. They are the two we read first.

1. Your resume

2. A link to your portfolio. We want to see short-form video you have edited yourself, not only static work

3. One or two sentences on our Instagram — 
 — go and look at it, then tell us one thing you would change and one thing you would keep. Be honest; we would genuinely rather hear a real criticism than a compliment

4. A few lines in your own words on why this role suits you. This one is for someone who wants to grow inside a tight-knit team and wants their work rewarded



Put the word PROCESS at the top so we know you read to the bottom.

title: CapCut only editor for Instagram Reels - Soft/warm AI educational video
description:
Hi I'm Cindy! I run an AI education brand with a 200k+ audience across two Instagram accounts. My reels teach people how to actually use Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and AI builds. I'm hiring editors to take a finished cut and turn it into the finished video. My style is a cute + scrapbook style and I explain AI concepts and builds.



Role description



You get the cut with the bad takes and pauses already removed. I also provide my editors an Editing Guide which includes where to grab screenshots/ screen recordings, so you're never working on a blank page. You'll also have the support of my Senior Editors, who can guide you to align closely with my style. 



Here's the role:

- Understand the concept being taught or refer to the Editing Guide for more inspiration.

- Source and build the screen recordings. If I'm talking about a tool, the viewer needs to see it in action. You capture or assemble those and align them to the exact words they belong to.

- Sound design. Every visual reveal gets a sound cue: a pop, a click, a page turn, a soft ding. There is no music. My voice plus sound effects carry the whole video.

- Good pacing. 



The short version: I explain the idea out loud, and you build everything the viewer needs to see to understand it.



Hard requirements



- CapCut proficiency. 

- Comfortable capturing and editing screen recordings

- You use AI tools yourself. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be generating images and diagrams with them already.

- Strong eye for short-form pacing on Instagram

- Warm, cute, arts-and-crafts taste. Never corporate, never tech-bro.

- Fluent English, good enough to follow a technical explanation and know what it means

- Turnaround of 1 to 2 days per reel



Nice to have



- You already use Claude or ChatGPT day to day

- Experience editing for AI, tech or educational creators

- Familiar with current Instagram hook formats and retention edits



Hard nos



Hard whip-pans, glitch or VHS effects, trending transition packs, generic tech stock footage, corporate imagery, harsh blues and neon.



The editing support you get



- Editing Guide so you know which assets to grab or record.

- CapCut Pro 

- Reference videos for every video you edit so you have a place to grab inspiration

- The cut of each reel, already trimmed

- Clear, fast feedback so you can lock the style within a few reels

- Support from our Senior Editors



PAY



- USD $35 per reel, paid through Upwork as a milestone per reel.

- Rate increases as you align closer to my style. 

- Steady, consistent volume. We publish constantly and there is always more work.



How to apply



Answer the screening questions, and attach 2 to 3 short-form samples you personally edited (CapCut preferred). Start your first answer with the words "capcut teams" so I know you read the whole post.

title: Lifestlye Manager (Luxury and Travel)
description:
We're searching for a lifestyle manager to join our member experience team. You'll communicate with members, anticipate their needs, and coordinate all the logistics to deliver a world-class experience.



Please note: this job isn't for everyone. We expect an extremely high standard of work from everyone in our team, and reward that work accordingly.



About us:

We're an AI-enabled lifestyle curation startup, serving a private community of ultra high net-worth members around the globe. We proactively curate and deliver on-demand luxury dining, travel, entertainment, and wellness experiences to our members.

title: Cold Caller and Database Creator
description:
PART-TIME BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & LEAD GENERATION COORDINATOR



Remote – Philippines | 20 Hours Per Week | USD $5.50 Per Hour + Bonuses



Are you confident on the phone, great at talking to people and good at opening doors?



We are a growing Australian business group operating across several industries, with a strong presence in events, entertainment, activations, markets, partnerships and new business ventures.



We are looking for a confident and personable Business Development & Lead Generation Coordinator to help us connect with potential clients, introduce our businesses and create new opportunities.



This is not aggressive telemarketing and we don't want someone reading a robotic script.



Your job is to make genuine contact with prospective clients, introduce who we are, find the right decision-maker, start a conversation and create an opportunity for our Australian team to take forward.



HOURS & PAY



20 hours per week – part-time and remote.



Starting rate: USD $5.50 per hour



This equates to approximately USD $475–$500 per month base, depending on hours worked.



There is also an opportunity to earn performance bonuses for generating quality opportunities and new business.



Our proposed bonus structure includes:



USD $5 bonus for a genuinely qualified meeting booked

Additional USD $10–$20 bonus where a lead converts into a new client, depending on the value of the opportunity

Salary review after 3 months based on performance, reliability, initiative and results



For someone who consistently performs well, there will be opportunity for both rate increases and additional hours as the role develops.



A significant portion of your working hours will need to overlap with Australian business hours as you will be speaking directly with Australian businesses and organisations.



THE ROLE



You will work across several different brands and campaigns, so the role is varied and there is always something new to work on.



One day you might be contacting shopping centres about entertainment and activations.



Another day you may be speaking with councils, venues, businesses, sponsors, clubs or corporate organisations about one of our other services or projects.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your role will include:



Researching prospective clients and organisations

Finding the correct decision-makers and contact details

Making outbound calls to Australian businesses

Introducing our company and services in a friendly, professional way

Starting conversations with prospective clients

Identifying businesses that may have a genuine need for our services

Asking the right questions to understand upcoming opportunities

Obtaining the correct
 address for proposals and information

Sending company information, capability documents and introductory
s

Following up information that has already been sent

Reconnecting with previous clients and contacts

Following up warm leads and enquiries

Booking calls or meetings for our Australian management team where appropriate

Keeping clear notes on every conversation

Building and maintaining prospect databases

Researching new industries and potential customer groups

Building targeted
 databases for future marketing campaigns

Updating CRM records and contact information

Identifying upcoming events, campaigns, developments and opportunities that may generate business

Helping create prospect lists for new services and brands

Keeping track of follow-ups so opportunities are not forgotten

Reporting on calls, contacts, leads and opportunities generated

THIS IS ABOUT OPENING DOORS



We are not expecting you to close large contracts on the first telephone call.



Your goal is to get us past:



"Who do I need to speak to?"



and move us towards:



"Yes, please send me some information."



or even better:



"That sounds interesting. Let's organise a meeting."



You will be the person who creates the beginning of that relationship.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO IS PROACTIVE



We don't want to hand you 100 phone numbers and simply ask you to call them.



We want someone who can also think:



"Who else could buy this?"



"What other companies should we approach?"



"Who is the right person inside this organisation?"



"They aren't interested now, but when should I contact them again?"



"I noticed this company has an event coming up — should we approach them?"



We want someone who enjoys finding opportunities and building a pipeline.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Speak excellent, confident English

Are comfortable talking to Australian businesses

Have a friendly and natural telephone manner

Are persuasive without being pushy

Don't get discouraged by hearing "no"

Can build rapport quickly

Are organised and reliable

Have excellent attention to detail

Can research businesses independently

Are confident using Google, LinkedIn and online directories

Can maintain databases accurately

Write professional
s

Follow up without needing to be constantly reminded

Can manage several different campaigns at once

Are comfortable working independently

Take initiative and look for opportunities



Previous experience in business development, appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, sales, virtual assistance or CRM/database management would be highly regarded.



Experience speaking with Australian, UK or US customers would also be an advantage.



THIS IS NOT A CALL-CENTRE ROLE



We care much more about quality conversations than simply hitting a ridiculous number of calls per hour.



We want our prospective clients to have a positive first impression of our businesses.



You should sound like part of our team — not like somebody reading from a script in a call centre.



There will be targets and accountability, but we will be looking at outcomes including:



Decision-makers identified

Genuine conversations

Information packs requested

Qualified leads generated

Follow-ups created

Meetings generated

Database growth

New opportunities uncovered

New clients generated

OPPORTUNITY TO GROW



Our businesses continue to expand and new projects are regularly being launched.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow with us and become an important part of our business development and sales team, with the potential for additional hours, increased pay and greater responsibility in the future.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself

Details of your previous outbound calling or business development experience

Any experience calling Australian businesses

The types of clients or industries you have previously contacted

CRM/database systems you have used

Your availability and the hours you can work

Confirmation that you are comfortable with the starting rate of USD $5.50 per hour + performance bonuses

A short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a prospective Australian client



And finally, tell us:



If we gave you a new service tomorrow and asked you to find 100 Australian businesses that might buy it, how would you approach the task?



We are looking for someone confident, resourceful and proactive who can become a genuine part of our growing team.



Please do not apply without including the requested voice recording.

title: Youtube Faceless Video Editor
description:
# Full-Time Video Editor — Faceless YouTube Channel (News/Story Content)



**Type:** Faceless YouTube channel, long-form story-driven news content

**Commitment:** Full-time, 6 days/week, 8 hours/day

**Schedule:** Fast-paced, daily deadlines — each video is scripted, edited, and approved same-day

**Resources provided:** Full VO script and reference video for every video



---



## About the Role



We run a fast-growing faceless YouTube channel producing long-form, story-driven videos on trending news. Every video starts from a professional voiceover script — your job is to bring it to life visually.



We're looking for a full-time video editor who can independently source footage, cut a polished long-form edit, and design a high-CTR thumbnail, consistently, every single day. This is a long-term role with stable pay and real growth potential as the channel scales.



**How the day works:** you'll receive a VO script and reference video, then edit, finalize, and submit for approval. The video is "done" once it's approved and no further revisions are needed. If you finish early and get approval ahead of schedule, your day can end early. If approval takes longer, you keep working until the video is finalized and accepted.



---



## What You'll Do



- **Edit 1 long-form video daily** (25–35 minutes), tightly synced to the provided VO script, with a polished, broadcast-quality finish.

- **Source and organize B-roll at volume** — dozens to hundreds of clips per video, pulled from stock libraries, YouTube archives, news footage, public event clips, interviews, archival material, paparazzi footage, and royalty-free assets. Every clip must match exactly what's being said in that moment — no generic filler, no "close enough" stock footage.

- **Match visuals precisely to narration.** If the script mentions a specific person, event, or moment, the footage on screen needs to reflect that specific moment — viewers should feel the video was built for the story, not assembled from whatever was on hand.

- **Keep retention high** across the full runtime with varied visuals: close-ups, reaction clips, text overlays, and relevant cutaways.

- **Add professional finishing touches** — subtitles/captions, smooth transitions, background music, and cinematic pacing built for retention.

- **Design 1 CTR-focused thumbnail daily** — bold, emotionally charged, YouTube-native style with strong visual hierarchy.

- **Maintain an organized shared asset library** and hit daily deadlines without needing follow-up.



---



## What You Need



- Proven proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

- Strong thumbnail design skills in Photoshop or Canva

- Strong research skills — the patience to find the *exact* clip for a 25–35 minute script, not just something close

- High attention to detail — visuals need to match narration precisely (e.g., if the script says "the garden party in 2018," the footage needs to be from that specific event, not a generic stand-in)

- Experience sourcing B-roll from stock libraries, YouTube archives, and public media

- A reliable workstation and fast internet capable of handling long-form projects

- Strong English comprehension (all scripts and voiceovers are in English)

- A sharp sense of storytelling, pacing, and retention for news-style content

- Good judgment on footage — knowing what adds emotional weight versus what's just noise

- Full-time availability: 6 days/week, 8 hours/day, delivering 1 complete video + 1 thumbnail daily, with prompt responses during working hours



---



## Bonus Points



- Experience editing news, current events, or royal/celebrity content

- Familiarity with royalty-free platforms (Storyblocks, Pexels, Artgrid, etc.) and basic audio mixing

- Solid grasp of YouTube CTR and retention best practices (hooks, pacing, visual variety)

- Experience on long-form content where retention past the 50% mark is a real priority



---



## How to Apply



Message me directly here, or
 with the subject line: **YouTube Editor Application – [Your Name]**



Please include:

1. An example of a long-form video you've edited (link preferred)

2. A YouTube-style thumbnail you've designed

3. Your editing/design tools (software + hardware specs)

4. Your availability — earliest start date and preferred 8-hour working schedule

title: Experienced E-Commerce Facebook Media Buyer & Creative Editor
description:
# Experienced E-Commerce
 Media Buyer & Creative Editor



**Remote Full-Time Position | $6/hour + Bonuses | Long-Term**



We are growing our e-commerce advertising team and are looking for someone who already has strong hands-on experience with **Meta Ads and e-commerce ad creatives.**



The ideal candidate can take a product and handle the advertising process from start to finish:



**Research → Create Ads → Launch Campaigns → Analyze Results → Improve Performance**



You must be comfortable both inside **Meta Ads Manager** and inside video editing software.



This is an important requirement.



We do not want a Media Buyer who depends on another person for every creative, and we do not want a video editor who does not understand advertising performance.



## Your Role



Your main responsibility will be to help us test and scale e-commerce products using
 and Instagram Ads.



A large part of your daily work will involve creating new advertising creatives.



You will research:



* Competitor advertisements

* Product demonstrations

* UGC content

* Customer reviews

* Product benefits

* Hooks

* Creative angles

* Existing winning advertisements



You will then turn this material into new e-commerce ads.



This includes:



* Video editing

* Strong opening hooks

* Text overlays

* Subtitles

* Voiceovers

* Product benefits

* Different calls to action

* Different creative angles

* Multiple variations of each ad



You should be able to create ads quickly while still understanding the purpose behind each creative.



Every creative should be designed to improve performance.



## Media Buying



You will personally launch and manage
 and Instagram campaigns.



Your daily work may include:



* Launching new product tests

* Launching new creatives

* Monitoring campaign performance

* Comparing creatives

* Identifying winning ads

* Stopping poor performers

* Optimizing campaigns

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Testing new angles

* Testing new offers

* Managing multiple products and stores



You should be able to work independently without needing instructions for every small campaign decision.



## Understanding KPIs



We place a lot of importance on KPI knowledge.



You must understand:



* CPA

* ROAS

* CTR

* CPC

* CPM

* Conversion Rate

* AOV

* Frequency

* Break-Even CPA

* Break-Even ROAS



More importantly, you should understand **what these numbers mean together.**



You should be able to recognize situations such as:



A low CTR may indicate a weak creative or hook.



A good CTR with poor sales may indicate a problem with the offer, product page, or conversion rate.



A high CPM does not automatically mean an ad is bad if the CPA and profitability are still strong.



A winning creative should lead to new variations, hooks, and angles being tested.



We are looking for someone who thinks this way naturally.



## Creative Skills



You should be comfortable creating ads yourself using tools such as:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Canva

* After Effects

* Other similar editing software



You should have a good understanding of **direct-response e-commerce advertising**, not only traditional video editing.



Your job is not to make cinematic videos.



Your job is to make videos that **sell products.**



## Additional Tasks



A smaller part of the role may involve adjusting landing pages or product pages.



We will usually provide existing templates or examples.



You may occasionally:



* Change images and videos

* Update product text

* Change prices or offers

* Check links and buttons

* Make simple page adjustments

* Check mobile and desktop layouts



Advanced web development is not required.



Basic Shopify, Wix, or similar experience is enough.



## Who We Are Looking For



You should already have:



* E-commerce
 Ads experience

* Physical product advertising experience

* Meta Ads Manager experience

* Creative testing experience

* Video editing experience

* Strong KPI knowledge

* Experience analyzing campaign performance

* Experience optimizing campaigns

* Experience scaling profitable campaigns

* Strong competitor research skills

* Good English communication

* Good organization and reliability



Experience with **lead generation only is not enough for this position.**



We specifically want someone who has worked with **e-commerce sales campaigns and understands purchase-focused advertising.**



## Compensation & Growth



* **Starting rate: $6 USD/hour**

* Weekly payments

* Performance bonuses

* Additional commissions possible

* Salary increases based on performance

* Fully remote

* Long-term position



We want someone who can stay with the team long-term.



Strong performers can eventually take on more responsibility, help train junior staff, and move into a Team Lead position.



We value people who can combine:



**Good Creatives + Good Media Buying + Good KPI Decisions**



If you understand all three, this role should be a strong fit.

title: GOOGLE ADS SPECIALIST – HIGH-INTENT, SAME-DAY PLUMBING LEADS
description:
GOOGLE ADS SPECIALIST – HIGH-INTENT, SAME-DAY PLUMBING LEADS



We are Genies Plumbing, a rapidly growing same-day residential plumbing company based on the Gold Coast, Australia, with plans to expand into Brisbane.



We need an experienced Google Ads specialist who can consistently generate high-quality phone calls from customers who need a plumber today.



This is not a basic VA, social-media or reporting role. I want somebody genuinely skilled at Google Ads for local service businesses.



THE MAIN OBJECTIVE



Generate profitable same-day plumbing enquiries for:



* Blocked drains

* CCTV drain inspections and jetting

* Pipe relining

* Leak detection

* Electric hot-water systems

* Emergency plumbing

* General plumbing maintenance



We want customers ready to book—not DIY searches, job seekers, sales representatives, suppliers or people shopping for plumbing products.



COMPLETE TRACKING IS ESSENTIAL



I want the entire customer journey tracked:



Google search → ad impression → ad click → landing page → phone call or form → genuine enquiry → booked job → completed job → revenue and gross profit.



I want reporting to clearly show:



* Impressions

* Clicks

* Click-through rate

* Cost per click

* Calls generated

* Cost per call

* Answered and missed calls

* Call duration

* Genuine versus junk calls

* Forms submitted

* Cost per genuine enquiry

* Booking rate

* Booked jobs

* Cost per booked job

* Completed jobs

* Revenue attributed to Google Ads

* Return on advertising spend

* Gross profit generated

* Results by campaign, service, location, keyword, search term, advertisement, landing page, device, day and time



A phone-number click is not automatically a lead. A call is not automatically a genuine enquiry, and an enquiry is not automatically a booked or profitable job.



I already use ServiceM8, Excel and internal reporting to track customers, jobs and revenue. I can provide the job outcomes. You must know how to connect and use this information to improve Google Ads, including offline conversion tracking where appropriate.



WHAT YOU WILL MANAGE



* Google Search campaigns

* Campaign and ad-group structure

* Keyword and search-intent strategy

* Exact and phrase-match selection

* Daily budget allocation

* Search-term reviews and negative keywords

* Bidding strategy

* Location, schedule and device targeting

* Advertisement and asset testing

* Service-specific landing-page direction

* Conversion and attribution quality

* Gold Coast campaign performance

    – Future Brisbane expansion

* Weekly optimisation and commercial reporting



We care about qualified calls, booked jobs, completed revenue and gross profit—not vanity figures.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS



* Approximately AUD $800,000–$1 million turnover

* Multiple technicians and vehicles

* More than 220 five-star Google reviews

* Same-day residential service

* Gold Coast base

* Brisbane expansion planned

* High-value opportunities in relining, drains, leak detection and hot water



ABOUT ME



I am the owner and will work directly with you.



I am technically capable and can build landing pages, implement tracking and make website changes quickly. I need someone who is better than me at paid-search strategy, account structure and optimisation.



All advertising accounts, campaigns, analytics, tracking and data will remain owned by Genies Plumbing.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* Strong practical Google Ads Search experience

* Local-service or home-service lead generation

* High-intent phone-call campaigns

* Google Tag Manager and GA4

* Call tracking and dynamic number insertion

* GCLID capture and offline conversion tracking

* Search-term and negative-keyword management

* Location targeting for service-area businesses

* Landing-page conversion strategy

* Using booked-job and revenue feedback to optimise advertising

* Clear written English and honest communication



Experience with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing or urgent home services is strongly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with “SAME-DAY LEADS.”



Then answer:



1. Describe one local-service Google Ads account you personally managed. Include the industry, location, monthly spend, qualified calls and cost per qualified lead.

2. Explain how you would track this journey:



Google click → phone call → genuine enquiry → ServiceM8 booking → completed job → revenue.



3. How would you calculate cost per call, cost per genuine enquiry and cost per booked job?

4. How would you structure campaigns for drains, emergency plumbing, leak detection, hot water, relining and general plumbing?

5. How frequently would you review search terms?

6. What would you do if a keyword generated cheap calls but none became booked jobs?

7. What bidding strategy would you initially use if reliable booked-job data wasn’t available?

8. Send evidence from an account you personally managed. Remove confidential client information.

9. Are you an individual or an agency? Who will personally work inside our account?

10. State your hourly or monthly rate and availability during Australian hours.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive exported Google Ads data and complete a paid three-hour assessment.



You will identify:



* The most important wasted expenditure

* The first three changes you would make

* The recommended campaign structure

* The tracking and attribution structure

* Which services should receive the initial budget

* A realistic 30/60/90-day plan

* What cannot be concluded from the available data



This is a long-term opportunity. As the business, locations, team and advertising budget grow, the role can grow with them.

title: Dispo Manager (Real Estate) - Find Cash Buyers and Get Our Deals Closed - Remote, US Hours
description:
We are a real estate investment company in Norfolk, Virginia, USA. We have been buying and selling houses since 2015 - more than 200 deals. We buy houses, fix some of them up and sell them, and pass others straight to other investors. We also own rental properties in Virginia and North Carolina.



We are hiring one person, full remote, 30 hours a week.



=====================================================

WHAT THIS JOB IS, IN PLAIN ENGLISH

=====================================================



We are good at finding houses to buy. We agree a price with the seller and we sign the contract.



Then the deal just sits there.



Somebody has to find the buyer, keep the paperwork moving, and make sure the deal actually closes and the money actually arrives. Right now nobody does that job. That is the job we are hiring for.



The industry word for it is "dispositions", or "dispo" for short. In plain English: once we own a house or have it under contract, you are the one who sells it.



You find the cash buyer. You agree the price with them. Then you stay on the deal every single day until it closes and we get paid.



=====================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

=====================================================



1. SELL THE DEALS



- Find the buyer for every house we put under contract. Cash buyers, landlords, other investors, and agents who work with investors.

- Build our buyers list. We do not really have one yet. You will build it and keep it warm, so that when a new deal comes in you already know who to call.

- Agree the price with the buyer and collect their deposit.

- If a deal is not selling, tell us early and tell us why - is it the price, the condition, the neighborhood, or the buyer pool? Do not wait until the week of closing.



2. GET THE DEAL TO CLOSING



- Keep one simple tracker of every deal we have under contract: the address, the price, the deadlines, the title company, the buyer, the closing date, and what needs to happen next.

- Watch the deadlines. Inspection, financing, deposit, title. Anything due in the next 5 days gets handled first.

- Call people. Title companies, lenders, closing attorneys. If someone does not reply to your
, you pick up the phone. An
 nobody answered is not a follow up.

- Keep the seller calm. Sellers get nervous after they sign. Check in with them at least once a week.

- Read the closing statement before anyone signs it and check the numbers against the contract. We had one last month where the numbers did not match and nobody caught it.



3. KEEP THE PIPELINE HONEST



Every morning you look at our CRM and make one list: every deal that needs something done today, who needs to do it, and by when. You bring that list to our 15 minute morning meeting. Anything nobody has touched in 48 hours, you send up to the Operations Manager.



At the end of each day you send a short note: what moved, what did not, what is stuck.



=====================================================

WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

=====================================================



- You are not a cold caller and not an appointment setter. We already have someone doing that.

- You are not a general virtual assistant. This is not inbox, calendar, or data entry work.

- You are not anybody's boss. Nobody reports to you. You work next to two teammates, not above them.

- You do not negotiate the buying price with sellers and you do not sign contracts. Your negotiating is on the selling side.

- You never move money and you never touch bank logins.



=====================================================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================================================



Must have:



- You have sold or assigned houses to cash buyers before, in US real estate. This is the main thing we are looking for. Wholesale assignments, novations, JV deals or flip sales all count.

- You have taken a deal from signed contract all the way through to closing, working with the title company or closing attorney.

- You are comfortable on the phone with Americans - buyers, sellers, title companies. Clear spoken English.

- You are organized about deadlines to the point where people tease you about it.

- You are willing to tell a teammate, in front of the team, that something on their plate has been sitting for eleven days.

- Reliable computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to take calls.



Nice to have, but not required:



- Experience with real estate CRMs (REsimpli, Podio, Salesforce or similar).

- Experience with buyer platforms like InvestorLift, DealMachine or Batch Leads.

- Experience with title portals (Qualia, ResWare, SoftPro).

- Lead management or ISA experience. Helpful background, but it is not what this job is measured on.



=====================================================

PAY, HOURS AND TERMS

=====================================================



PAY: $5.00 per hour, 30 hours per week.

PLUS a $250 bonus for every single deal that closes. There is no cap on this. We already have deals in the pipeline that nobody is working, so this bonus is not theoretical.



HOURS: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time. The 8:00 AM start is fixed because that is when our team meeting is.



TERMS: Independent contractor. 30 day trial period, both ways. Hours tracked in Hubstaff.



=====================================================

WHAT YOU GET FROM US

=====================================================



- A written manual for this job. The daily checklist, the escalation steps and the tracker fields are already written down. You are not improvising.

- A 15 minute morning meeting where your list is the agenda.

- A real escalation path. If you flag something and nobody moves, it goes to the Operations Manager and he acts on it.

- Direct access to the owners. No committee, no layers.

- Systems that already work - CRM, automated lead generation, automated property valuation, and a real vendor list of title companies, lenders, property managers and a CPA.

- A pipeline that already has deals in it and nobody working the back half.



=====================================================

HOW TO APPLY

=====================================================



Please answer these 8 questions in your application. We read every application that answers them. We do not read the ones that do not.



Number your answers 1 to 8.



1. Can you work Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, starting at 8:00 AM every day for our team meeting? (yes/no)



2. Are you willing to track your hours in Hubstaff, with screenshots and activity levels? (yes/no)



3. How many years have you personally worked US real estate dispositions - meaning you sold or assigned deals to end buyers? Pick one: none / 0-1 / 2-3 / 4-7 / 8+



4. What was your number in your last job? Tell us the actual thing you were measured on and the actual figure. For example: deals sold per month, average assignment fee, how many files you handled at once. If nobody ever measured you on a number, just say so - that is a fine answer, we would rather know.



5. Tell us about your buyers list. How did you build it from nothing? How many buyers were on it? How many of them bought from you more than once? What did you do to keep them interested? Please be specific about where the names came from.



6. Here is a real situation. You have a house under contract. Closing is in 9 days. You have no buyer yet, and the two people who walked through it have both gone quiet. What do you do, day by day, for the next 9 days? Who do you call, what would you change, and at what point do you tell the owner it is not going to sell?



7. Here is our real situation. We have deals under contract and no tracker at all. Nobody works for you - the two people who handle the front of the pipeline sit beside you as equals. What would you do in your first week? Day by day please.



8. You are reading the closing statement the day before closing. The commission line has been worked out on a sale price that is higher than the contract price printed on the same page. What do you do, in what order, and who do you call?

title: Remote Customer Service Agent (Live Chat & Email)
description:
We are looking for a reliable, experienced Customer Service Agent to handle live chat and
 support for a busy travel and ferry booking platform.



You will be responsible for resolving customer inquiries, processing booking changes, resolving booking problems, and providing clear, professional assistance in English. You will not be required to handle phone calls.



Hours: Part-time during the trial period (approximately 20 hours per week). The schedule is fully flexible and will be built around mutual availability. This does not have to follow a strict Monday to Friday pattern.



After 1 month, this could transition into a full time role (40 hours a week). This is intended as a reliable long term arrangement for the right person, not a short term gig. However, Full time is an option, not an expectation. Staying part time long term is equally fine if that suits you better.



Start Date: Immediate



PLEASE READ THE PAY SECTION BEFORE APPLYING. This role is paid on output = answers sent/tickets resolved. There is no hourly rate.



=====================================================================



WHAT YOU CAN EARN



=====================================================================



There is no hourly wage and no cap on what you can earn.



You earn between €0.26 and €0.56 for every ticket you resolve (about $0.30 to $0.65), depending on how complex it is. A typical ticket pays about €0.34 (about $0.40).



7 tickets an hour = about EUR 2.35 per hour (approx. $2.75)



9 tickets an hour = about EUR 3.05 per hour (approx. $3.55)



11 tickets an hour = about EUR 3.70 per hour (approx. $4.30)



14 tickets an hour = about EUR 4.70 per hour (approx. $5.45)



16 tickets an hour = about EUR 5.40 per hour (approx. $6.25)



Most agents settle at around 11 to 16 tickets an hour once they know the systems. Earnings depend partly on ticket complexity, so these figures are a guide rather than a guarantee.



These are realistic numbers, not best case ones. The middle and upper rows are where agents actually work once they are past the learning curve. The trial minimum is set deliberately below that, because you will still be learning the systems and the templates.



There is no shortage of tickets. There is always work waiting during your hours, so what you earn depends on how much you get through, not on how busy the platform you will work on happens to be that day.



Every ticket you resolve is logged in a platform. Your work is recorded ticket by ticket, so that can always be verified. Nothing rests on anyone's word or memory.



Paid WEEKLY, for the week just finished, in EUROS, to an account in your own name. The payment method is agreed before you start.



=====================================================================



STAGES



=====================================================================



1. TRAINING



One paid session of four hours, at EUR 2.60 per hour (about $3.00), paid in two instalments across your first month.



2. TRIAL



Seven working days, four hours a day. By the end of it you should be resolving at least 7 to 9 tickets an hour, which works out at about EUR 2.35 to EUR 3.05 an hour (about $2.75 to $3.55).



3. EVALUATION



About one month at around 20 hours a week, working to a minimum of 10 to 11 tickets an hour, about EUR 3.40 to EUR 3.70 an hour (about $3.90 to $4.30). Full time hours can be discussed during this period itself if you are hitting the targets and the quality is there.



4. ONGOING



Up to 40 hours a week on a long term basis. Full time is an option, not an expectation. Staying part time long term is equally fine if that suits you better.



The ticket figures above are MINIMUM PERFORMANCE LEVELS, not guaranteed earnings. You are paid for what you resolve.



Nothing is automatic. Moving to the next stage is agreed in writing, and you will always know where you stand.



This is meant to be a reliable long term arrangement, not a short term gig. The stages exist so that we both know it works before either of us commits to it. For the right person who gets through them, the aim is steady ongoing hours over the long run, not a few weeks of cover.



=====================================================================



HOURS



=====================================================================



This role runs on UK business hours, because customers are in Europe. The working window is 10am to 8pm UK time, and you choose a consistent block of at least four hours inside it. You are not expected to be available for the whole window.



Manila is 7 hours ahead of the UK until late October, and 8 hours ahead after that. The window in Manila time:



Now until late October: 5pm to 3am



From late October: 6pm to 4am



Please only apply if a four hour block inside that window suits you long term, remembering that it shifts by an hour in late October. The window can be reviewed later on for the right person.



Inside it the schedule is fully flexible and built around mutual availability. It does not have to follow a Monday to Friday pattern. Hours are agreed in writing each week and confirmed several days ahead.



START DATE: IMMEDIATE. Candidates available within the next few days will be prioritised.



=====================================================================



WHAT YOU WILL DO



=====================================================================



• Respond to customer inquiries via live chat and
 promptly and professionally.



• Resolve issues related to travel bookings, cancellations, modifications, and general platform support.



• Follow guidelines, templates, and quality standards according to the knowledge base provided to ensure consistent service.



• Maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in all written communications.



• Connect via secure remote desktop software (AnyDesk) during agreed working hours. You will connect to one of our computers/machines and work from that.



=====================================================================



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



=====================================================================



Experience: Proven experience in live chat and
 customer support (experience in travel/tourism, hospitality, or e-commerce is a strong advantage). Candidates without customer support experience will be rejected.



Language: Excellent written English with a professional, empathetic tone.



Technical Setup: A reliable, fast internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace.



Experience with Intercom is a strong advantage, though not essential — candidates familiar with any major live chat platform (Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar) are welcome to apply.



Availability: You must have a consistent block of at least 4 hours available per day on your agreed working days, with no conflicting commitments. Exact days and hours will be agreed with the successful candidate.



Pace: You must be comfortable working at pace and handling multiple customer conversations simultaneously.



Remote Access: You must be comfortable working via remote desktop software (AnyDesk). You will connect and control one of our computers.



Availability to Start: Immediate start preferred. Candidates who are available to begin within the next few days will be prioritised.



Proof of experience : A Certificate of Employment, or equivalent written proof, covering the most recent roles listed in your CV. This is required before any work begins. Please do not apply if you cannot obtain it.



Identification: A valid government issued ID is required before any work begins. A PhilSys National ID, Passport, driver's licence, UMID or PRC ID is fine.



Security: A strong understanding of data confidentiality. You must be willing to sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before commencing work.



Confidentiality. You will handle real customer data belonging to third parties. A confidentiality agreement must be signed before you start, and it is enforced.



=====================================================================



WHAT YOU GET



=====================================================================



- A flexible schedule inside the hours window, agreed with you every week



- Paid weekly rather than monthly, so you are never waiting a month for work you have already done



- No cap on earnings. The faster and more accurate you get, the more you make



- Written support only. No phone calls



- You deal directly with one person, not a call centre floor



- Honest feedback whenever you ask for it, and a route to full time hours if you want them



=====================================================================



HOW TO APPLY



=====================================================================



We receive a high volume of applications, so we use a simple test to ensure you have read this description carefully.



To apply, please submit your application and include the phrase "Blue Ferry Support" at the very beginning of your cover letter or application message. Applications without this phrase will be automatically declined.



In your application, please briefly outline:



1. Your experience handling live chat and
 support.



2. That you can provide a Certificate of Employment for the most recent roles in your CV and a valid government ID (say which ones).



3. That you have read and understood the pay section.



We look forward to hearing from you.

description:
Description



We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own and manage the majority of our digital business. This role is ideal for someone with a strong small business background who is comfortable managing day-to-day operations and stepping into the details when needed.

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for a high-level executive who operates far from execution. We are looking for someone who can manage and do.



Responsibilities

• Platform Ownership: Owning the end-to-end e-commerce operation across Amazon as the primary platform.  

• Vendor & Agency Management: Acting as the main point of contact for agencies and third-party vendors, including managing vendor contacts and leading negotiations.  

• Daily Operations: Overseeing technical, operational, and day-to-day e-commerce activities, including product additions, integrations, and customer service escalations.  

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Representing the company on technical, operational, and integration-related calls, and coordinating with in-person staff regarding e-commerce operations.  

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicating clearly with company owners on progress, issues, and priorities.  Problem Solving: Getting hands-on when needed to resolve technical or operational issues and unblock operations.

• Exposure to Walmart or eBay is a plus but not required.  

• Comfort managing integrations, apps, and technical workflows.  

• Proven experience working with agencies, external partners, and managing vendor negotiations.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end e-commerce operations, workflows, and vendor relationship management.

Nice to Have Skills

title: Graphic/Digital Designer

- You're an exceptional all-round designer with at least three years of commercial experience.

- You're naturally curious, take ownership of your work, and care about producing creative that solves problems - not just looks good.

title: Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator (Part-Time)
description:
Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator (Part-Time)

Location: Remote

Hours: 20 hours per week, 9:00am–1:00pm (UK Time)

Working arrangement: Part-time



Overview



Our client is a specialist marketing agency supporting agricultural, rural and other service-based businesses. We are looking for a Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator to work alongside the founder and existing marketing team.



This is primarily an implementation and technical delivery role, rather than a marketing strategy, copywriting or graphic design position. The successful candidate will take approved marketing, website and systems requirements and turn them into reliable, functioning digital solutions.



The role will include website implementation, marketing systems, CRM and
 platforms, automations, integrations, analytics and technical troubleshooting across a number of different client accounts. We are looking for someone who is technically confident, organized and able to take ownership of projects without requiring constant direction.



Key Responsibilities



Website Management & Implementation



Update, manage and maintain WordPress websites, primarily using Elementor

Create and edit website pages from supplied briefs, copy and design direction

Build landing pages for campaigns and lead generation

Make responsive adjustments for desktop, tablet and mobile

Upload and format website content

Build and configure website forms

Connect forms with CRM,
 marketing and automation platforms

Manage plugins and perform routine website maintenance

Support staging, website backups and migrations where required

Troubleshoot common WordPress and Elementor issues

Make basic CSS adjustments where appropriate

Support integrations with membership, ecommerce and other third-party systems

Carry out basic domain, DNS, SSL and website hosting troubleshooting where appropriate

Test website functionality before work is considered complete



The role does not require advanced bespoke website development or full-stack development. More complex development requirements may be referred to an external specialist.



Marketing Technology & Automation



Set up and manage
 marketing and CRM systems

Build
 nurture sequences and automated customer journeys

Create and manage automations and workflows

Connect systems using Zapier or comparable integration platforms

Troubleshoot failed automations and integrations

Configure forms, tags, lists, segments and triggers

Test automation journeys before launch

Identify opportunities to improve the reliability or efficiency of existing systems

Document important workflows and integrations so they can be understood and maintained by the wider team



Analytics, Tracking & Digital Systems



Implement and maintain basic website analytics and tracking

Support Google Analytics, Search Console and similar platforms

Implement Meta pixels and other basic marketing tracking requirements

Support Google Business Profile and related digital platforms when required

Carry out basic technical SEO implementation where appropriate

Troubleshoot account connections, permissions and system errors across client marketing platforms



Technical Problem Solving



Investigate and resolve practical technical problems across client systems

Diagnose the likely source of an issue rather than simply following instructions

Research unfamiliar platforms or problems where appropriate

Explain technical issues clearly and simply to non-technical team members and clients

Recognise when an issue requires specialist support and escalate it promptly rather than spending excessive time attempting to solve something outside the scope of the role



Project Management & Working Practices



Strong project management and communication are an important part of this role. The successful candidate will be expected to:



Review requirements before beginning significant pieces of work

Provide realistic estimates of the likely time required where appropriate

Raise concerns if work is likely to exceed the original time estimate

Keep assigned Asana tasks accurate and up to date

Record progress, blockers and next steps clearly

Communicate promptly when access, information or client input is preventing progress

Escalate technical problems early if significant investigation is not producing progress

Work systematically rather than allowing technical troubleshooting to become open-ended

Test and quality-check work before marking tasks as complete

Document important technical changes, integrations and configurations



Examples of quality assurance may include checking: desktop, tablet and mobile website layouts; website links and buttons; forms and submissions; automated
s; CRM records; integrations; tracking; permissions and user journeys.



Essential Skills & Experience



We are more interested in strong technical ability and transferable experience than experience with every specific platform used. Candidates should have:



Strong practical experience with WordPress

Strong working knowledge of Elementor

Experience creating and editing website pages

Experience troubleshooting WordPress websites

Experience with website forms and integrations

Experience using at least one established CRM or
 marketing platform

Experience building
 automations or automated workflows

Experience using Zapier or a comparable integration platform

Basic understanding of website analytics and marketing tracking

Good general understanding of how websites, forms, CRMs,
 systems and third-party platforms connect

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Confidence working independently on project-based tasks

Strong written communication

The ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people



Platforms You May Work With



Existing systems currently include or may include: WordPress, Elementor, MailerLite, Kit, Zoho, Keap, AWeber, Zapier, MemberPress, CloudCampaign, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Meta Business Suite, Asana, Google Workspace.



Experience with every platform listed is not required. Someone with strong transferable technical skills who is confident learning unfamiliar platforms would be considered.



Useful Additional Experience



It would be advantageous to have experience with: membership websites, ecommerce websites, CRM migrations, domain and DNS management, website hosting environments, staging websites and migrations, basic CSS, Meta Business Suite, marketing pixels and conversion tracking, basic technical SEO, supporting several different client accounts simultaneously, and working within a marketing agency or outsourced marketing environment.



Ideal Candidate



The right person is likely to be: technically curious and confident; a practical problem-solver; comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems; able to work independently without becoming isolated; organised and systematic; reliable with deadlines and communication; realistic about how long work will take; comfortable flagging a problem or asking for help early; able to distinguish between productive troubleshooting and spending too much time on an issue; detail-oriented when testing their own work; happy working across several different client systems; able to communicate technical information simply and clearly.



We particularly value someone with a "figure it out, test it and communicate it" mindset.



What This Role Is Not



This role is not primarily responsible for: marketing strategy, copywriting, graphic design, social media content creation, advanced bespoke website development, full-stack development, general diary or inbox management, or general virtual-assistant work. Marketing strategy, copywriting and creative direction are handled elsewhere within the team.



The Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator's primary responsibility is the technical implementation and reliable delivery of approved marketing activity.

title: UK Property Acquisitions & Research Assistant
description:
# UK Property Acquisitions & Research Assistant



**Part-time | Remote | Long-term opportunity**



I’m a UK property investor looking for a capable, self-motivated acquisitions and research assistant to help me find and assess property investment opportunities. I want to find someone who can grow into my business and become a key part of how we source deals.



**The main focus of this role is property deal sourcing.** I’m looking for someone who already has a good understanding of UK property investment and can contribute from the beginning, while continuing to learn and develop.



### A long-term role with room to grow



I’m looking for someone who wants to make a **long-term commitment and become part of my property business**. This isn’t a short-term project or a role where I want to keep replacing people. My aim is to find the right person, invest time in their development and build a working relationship that lasts.



I have my own approach to finding and assessing property deals, and I’d like someone who is willing to learn that approach and **grow into the way my business operates**. Over time, I want you to understand my buying criteria, the types of opportunities I’m looking for and how I make investment decisions, so you can take on more responsibility and become increasingly independent.



As the business grows, I’d like the role to grow with it. There may be opportunities for more hours, greater responsibility and improved pay as you develop and demonstrate your value.



### What you’ll be working on



**Residential property deal sourcing**



Finding potential BMV, flip, BRR and value-add opportunities through property portals, auction houses, price reductions, unsold lots and other sources. Researching sold comparables, rental evidence, property history and the potential for refurbishment or other value creation.



**Direct-to-vendor sourcing**



Helping identify potential motivated sellers and off-market opportunities, researching property ownership and building lead lists, making appropriate initial contact where agreed, and keeping track of follow-ups and opportunities.



**Commercial property sourcing**



Researching vacant or underperforming commercial properties, auction opportunities and other situations where there may be an opportunity to add value through refurbishment, letting, lease improvements or a change in how the property is used.



**Self-storage site sourcing**



Helping identify potential sites or buildings suitable for self-storage, including commercial buildings, yards and land. I’ll provide the specific criteria we’re looking for, but an understanding of commercial property, access, planning considerations and site research would be useful.



**Occasional refurbishment support**



When I’m carrying out a refurbishment, there may be some work contacting builders or suppliers, obtaining quotes, researching materials or helping keep track of project-related tasks. This is a supporting part of the role rather than the main focus.



### The kind of person I’m looking for



You should already have **some meaningful experience with UK property investment research or deal sourcing**. Ideally, you’ll understand concepts such as BMV, BRR, flips, GDV, rental yield, refurbishment costs and sold comparables. Experience with direct-to-vendor sourcing, auctions or commercial property would be a strong advantage.



You don’t need to be an expert in every area. I’m more interested in someone who has a solid foundation, enjoys property, is good at research and can learn how I assess opportunities.



You should be comfortable using tools such as Rightmove, Zoopla, OnTheMarket, auction websites, HM Land Registry, Google Sheets/Excel and other property research platforms. Experience with PropertyData, Nimbus, LandInsight or similar tools would be useful, but isn't essential.



Good written English, attention to detail and the ability to work independently are important. I want someone who can explain **why a property might be an opportunity**, not just send me a list of links.



### Training and development



I’m happy to invest time in training the right person. I’ll explain my buying criteria, show you how I assess deals and provide feedback on the opportunities you find.



I’m also happy for you to use some of your **paid working time for agreed training**, including relevant property-investment courses, research, podcasts or other learning that helps you improve in the role. The aim is to build your knowledge over time so you can take on more responsibility.



I don’t expect you to know everything from day one, but I do want someone who already knows enough to contribute and is genuinely motivated to keep learning.



### Hours and arrangement



This will initially be a **part-time, long-term role of around 10–15 hours per week**, with the possibility of increasing the hours as the role develops. The work is remote and can be flexible, although some overlap with UK working hours would be useful for contacting agents, auctioneers and other UK contacts.



Pay will depend on your relevant experience and the hours agreed. I’m looking for someone who wants a consistent, ongoing working relationship.



### How to apply



Please tell me about your experience with **UK property investment or deal sourcing**, particularly BMV, BRR, flips, auctions, D2V or commercial property. I’d also be interested to know which property research tools you have used.



If possible, include a brief example of a property opportunity you have researched and explain what made it interesting. Please also let me know your hourly rate, availability and whether you’re looking for a long-term part-time role.



**I’m not looking for someone who knows everything. I’m looking for someone who already knows enough to contribute, is genuinely interested in property and wants to become very good at this work.**

title: Part-Time B2B Commercial Outreach Caller – Australian Market
description:
Sparkle Window Cleaning is looking for a part-time remote contractor to make polite, structured B2B calls to businesses in Brisbane, Australia.



The initial focus is low-rise offices and clinics that may need periodic exterior window or property cleaning. Existing enquiries and approved introductions will be prioritised. This is an outreach and qualification role, not a closing or quoting role.



What you will do

- Attempt contact with around 20 approved new businesses per week, usually on Tuesdays and Thursdays during Brisbane business hours. Repeat calls are tracked separately and do not count as new businesses.

- Introduce yourself and Sparkle Window Cleaning clearly.

- Ask for the person responsible for exterior cleaning or property maintenance.

- Ask whether the business is reviewing this work now or later in the year.

- Ask permission for Aya from Sparkle to send information or arrange a callback.

- Record the call result and a short, accurate note on the same day.

- Immediately record any “do not call again” request.



What you will not do

- You will not quote prices or create estimates.

- You will not promise dates, visits, safety outcomes, insurance coverage, access arrangements or contract terms.

- You will not send unauthorised
 or SMS.

- You will not call businesses outside the approved list.

- You will not save customer or prospect data to a personal device or personal CRM.

- You will use only the Sparkle-approved business calling route and your own company-issued login.



What we are looking for

- Clear, natural spoken English suitable for Australian business calls.

- Experience with B2B calling, preferably calling Australian businesses.

- Good listening, concise note-taking and respectful handling of receptionists and refusals.

- The judgement to say that a Sparkle team member will follow up when asked about price, timing, safety, insurance or scope.

- Reliable computer, headset and internet connection during agreed Brisbane-time hours.



Pay and pilot

- Paid six-week pilot.

- Approximately 3–4 paid hours per week, including preparation, training, calls, result entry and a short review.

- A$3–4 per hour depending on English communication, calling experience and quality during the paid test.

- The first five calls are paid. There is no unpaid trial.



To apply, please provide

1. A 45–60 second English voice sample introducing yourself and asking to speak with the person responsible for exterior cleaning.

2. A short summary of your B2B calling experience.

3. Any experience calling Australian businesses.

4. Your availability in Brisbane time, including Tuesday and Thursday options.

5. Your expected hourly rate within A$3–4.

6. Your computer, headset and internet setup.

7. Short answers to these scenarios: what would you say if the prospect asks for a price; what would you do if reception will not transfer the call; and what would you do if the prospect asks never to be called again?



Please do not send customer data, private client records or confidential employer information in your application. Business calls may be recorded, transcribed and reviewed for training and quality purposes; this will be explained before any work begins.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Python & Next.js | Part-Time Growing to Full-Time & Technical Lead | AI Automation & Clien
description:
We're ScaleSage — UK-based AI automation and client acquisition specialists, one venture inside The Machine Collective. Our platform is nearly built: Python/FastAPI back end, Next.js front end on Vercel, Postgres on Supabase, Stripe, cold
 through the Instantly and Apollo APIs, a conversational diagnostic funnel, a partner commission engine, CI-gated deployments to a Mac Mini production box behind Cloudflare Tunnels, and a growing set of AI agents.



You'll take the platform over from the current developer during a structured handover, finish it to a proven standard, and then build what comes next — a client platform, a content production product, and a search and AI visibility product — all scoped and all yours to own.



Here's the honest situation. A lot has been built. From now on nothing is called done until it's demonstrated working, estimates are real and kept, and every hour is accounted for.



If that sounds like pressure, this isn't your role. If it sounds like how good engineering should work anyway, keep reading.



HOW THIS WORKS



We start on a monthly retainer at ~20 hours a week, on a fixed weekly pattern you propose and we agree, with at least three hours of daily overlap with Bangkok and Manila working hours.



Nothing here is promised. Everything is earned. The path is written into the contract: part-time to prove the fit, expanded part-time as you deliver, full-time when the business and your delivery earn it, and then technical lead across the group's ventures. Full-time follows delivery, not time served.



What we hire for, in order: finishing what you start; proving it works before you call it done; clear, precise written and spoken English, because nothing can get lost in translation here; being extremely organised; and an eye for detail, for design, and for what premium quality actually is. Our clients pay for premium and can tell the difference.



WHAT YOU'LL INHERIT



FastAPI services on Docker Compose on a Mac Mini behind Cloudflare Tunnels and Tailscale; Postgres on Supabase with Alembic migrations and row-level security; GitHub Actions CI gating deploys; Instantly, Apollo, Hunter, Google Places and Companies House APIs; Stripe with webhooks; HeyGen and ElevenLabs for generated video and voice; an e-signature flow; scheduled jobs; LLM agents with per-run cost tracking; Slack alerting. All of it real, all of it in production today.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



The 30-day trial starts on day one and runs alongside the outgoing developer for as long as he's there, overlapping for the remainder of his notice period so you inherit the platform safely before he's gone.



Own the platform end to end. Nothing is called done below proven, with evidence:



Daily written EOD: completed, active, blocked, next — with hours

Four status words for all work — architected, coded, live, proven

One live demonstration call a week, working things shown on screen, plus short recorded walkthroughs

Blockers raised the same day they appear

Time tracking through an agreed tool

Any other client work disclosed in writing before it starts



Post-trial. You own the platform and scope and build what's next: a client platform, a content production product, and a search and AI visibility product. Not a phased roadmap — you're shipping what the business needs as it needs it.



A candidate who takes clean ownership of the platform and closes out the handover meets the bar. One who backs every claim with a proven demo is doing this role well. One who also spots what's inefficient or under-specified and improves the plan is exceptional.



MUST HAVE



Python and FastAPI in production

Postgres and Supabase, schema design and migrations, background jobs and schedulers, webhooks

Next.js and React on Vercel, Tailwind, responsive layouts that look right on a phone, CSS animation and motion, and the ability to take a Figma or visual reference and build it to the pixel

Stripe subscriptions and one-off payments, REST API integration with third-party SaaS

 sending and deliverability

Docker, CI pipelines, Linux, Cloudflare Tunnels, backups and restore, secrets handled properly

LLM APIs, prompt and agent design, evaluation of outputs

Automated tests, QA on real devices, security and data-protection basics

Documentation good enough that someone else could take over

Excellent written and spoken English — you'll write daily EODs and speak on a weekly demo call, and English is tested live on the screening call

Self-managing: able to take a brief and ship without hand-holding

Reliable internet, a quiet workspace



If you're strong in most of these and honest about the rest, apply.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience taking over an existing, undocumented codebase and making it safe to change

Background in an agency or client-services environment where "done" has to be provable to someone else

Exposure to content production tooling or SEO/AI-search-visibility work

Working knowledge of UK GDPR and PECR as they apply to cold
: suppression, unsubscribe handling, eligibility

Active GitHub with public commits in the last 90 days

Entrepreneurial mindset — you've tried to build something yourself



You don't need to know everything already. But you need to be the kind of person who can learn a new tool fast, build with it, and document what you did so the rest of the team can use it.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:



A short recorded video, under three minutes, on why this role and how you'd approach the first week.

Answers to the seven questions below, directly in your application. Applications without them are not read. Give real examples — generic answers are exactly what this is screening against:

Describe a system you built end to end and are proud of: the stack, what it does, what's live today, and what you'd do differently.

Have you taken over someone else's system? Give an example: what you were handed, what was missing, and how you got to the point of being able to change it safely.

Give an example of a deadline you missed. When did you tell the client, what did you say, and what changed afterwards?

Describe something you shipped that later turned out not to work in production. How was it found, and what did you change so it wouldn't happen again?

What is your current client load in hours per week, and what fixed windows could you give this role, in Bangkok time?

Send a link to something you've built where the front end is yours, and tell us one thing about it you'd fix if you had an hour.

You'll have Claude Code and Codex. Tell us how you use them and how you know what they produce is right.



If your answer to question 4 is "that has never happened to me," this isn't the role for you.



In return: real freedom in how and when you work, a direct line to the founder, a documented system, and a company that wants you to grow into leading it.



Process



Written screen → 30-minute call → short technical test → two client references → contract with a 30-day trial.



State your monthly retainer for 20 hours a week and your full-time rate.
