JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: DTC Content Strategist & Operator — 8-Figure Shopify Brands

.

4. Skim

title: Data Operations Specialist (Microsoft Excel Expert)
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Data Operations Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1100 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized Data Operations Specialist to support daily data operations, reporting, data quality, and business analysis. This role will be responsible for collecting, consolidating, validating, organizing, and maintaining large datasets from multiple systems while ensuring data is accurate, complete, and readily available for internal reporting and decision-making.



The ideal candidate has strong Excel and data management skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently with large volumes of data across multiple sources. This position requires someone who can identify discrepancies, maintain consistent data structures, prepare recurring reports, and turn operational data into clear, actionable insights. Experience with e-commerce, Amazon Seller Central, ERP systems, or business reporting is a plus.



Key Responsibilities:



Data Management & Operations

* Collect, consolidate, and maintain data from multiple sources and systems.

* Perform data entry, cleaning, validation, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and completeness.

* Identify data discrepancies, missing information, duplicates, and other data quality issues.

* Maintain standardized data structures, SKU/item mappings, and master data.

* Monitor data updates and ensure information remains accurate and up to date.



Reporting & Analysis

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational and business reports.

* Build and maintain Excel/Google Sheets reports, dashboards, and tracking files.

* Analyze sales, inventory, purchasing, shipment, and other operational data.

* Perform variance analysis and identify trends, exceptions, and potential issues.

* Support ad hoc data analysis and reporting requests from management.

* Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and reduce manual or repetitive processes.

* Maintain clear documentation and standardized processes for recurring data operations.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.

* 1–3 years of experience in data operations, business analysis, reporting, or a similar role.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including functions such as SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IFERROR, and Pivot Tables.

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data inconsistencies and discrepancies.

* Ability to work with large datasets and maintain a high level of accuracy and completeness.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, variances, exceptions, and potential issues.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet recurring reporting deadlines.

* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings and data-related issues.

* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and follow standardized data processes.

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central or Amazon Marketplace data is preferred.

* Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite is preferred.

* Experience with e-commerce or retail operations is preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS VA BTX HOMES LLC | Remote – Philippines
description:
REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS VA

BTX HOMES LLC | Remote – Philippines



Position: Real Estate Acquisitions VA

Company: BTX Homes LLC

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Part-Time initially, with opportunity for Full-Time

Starting Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour based on experience

Schedule: Monday–Friday with required U.S. business-hour overlap

Industry: U.S. Real Estate Investing / Wholesaling



ABOUT BTX HOMES



BTX Homes LLC is a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties, distressed houses, land, and development opportunities.



Our Lead Generation Team finds potential properties.



Your job is to turn those leads into conversations with property owners and ultimately contracts.



This is a sales and acquisitions position, not a general VA position.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



You will receive leads generated by our virtual Driving for Dollars team.



You will:



CALL → TEXT → FOLLOW UP → QUALIFY → NEGOTIATE → SUBMIT OFFER → FOLLOW UP → GET CONTRACT



Your goal is to create real seller conversations and signed contracts.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. CALL NEW LEADS



Call every new qualified lead assigned to you.



Your objectives are to:



Reach the property owner

Introduce BTX Homes

Determine whether they are interested in selling

Ask questions about the property

Understand their situation

Determine motivation

Determine timeline

Determine price expectations

Determine property condition

Determine occupancy

Determine whether there are repairs needed

2. TEXT EVERY LEAD



When appropriate, send an SMS after the call.



If the seller doesn't answer:



CALL → VOI
 → TEXT → FOLLOW UP



Do not simply call once and move on.



3. FOLLOW-UP EVERY DAY



This is one of the MOST IMPORTANT parts of the job.



Most sellers will NOT sell after the first conversation.



You must consistently follow up.



Follow-up may include:



Day 1: Call + text



Day 2: Call + text



Day 3: Call



Day 5: Call + text



Day 7: Call



Day 10: Text



Day 14: Call + text



Day 21: Call



Day 30: Call + text



Then continue the appropriate long-term follow-up campaign.



4. NEVER LOSE A LEAD



Every seller must have a clear status in the CRM.



Examples:



New Lead

Attempting Contact

Contacted

Interested

Motivated

Follow-Up

Offer Needed

Offer Sent

Negotiating

Verbal Agreement

Contract Sent

Under Contract

Not Interested

Wrong Number

Do Not Contact



Every conversation must be documented.



5. QUALIFY THE SELLER



When you reach the owner, collect:



PROPERTY

Property address

Property type

Bedrooms

Bathrooms

Approximate square footage

Occupied or vacant

Current tenant situation

Condition

Roof condition

HVAC

Plumbing

Electrical

Kitchen

Bathrooms

Major repairs needed

SELLER

Why are they considering selling?

How long have they owned it?

What is their desired timeline?

Are they currently living there?

Are there other owners?

Is there a mortgage?

Are there liens or other issues they know about?

PRICE



Ask:



"If we were able to purchase the property as-is and make the process easy for you, what price would you be looking for?"



Do NOT immediately give the seller our maximum price.



6. IDENTIFY MOTIVATION



We are looking for sellers with a legitimate reason to sell.



Examples:



Vacant property

Inherited property

Landlord tired of the property

Major repairs

Property needs updating

Relocation

Divorce

Estate

Behind on payments

Long-term ownership

Property is becoming a burden

Wants to sell quickly

Wants to avoid making repairs



Do not pressure sellers.



We want to solve problems and create win-win transactions.



7. SEND QUALIFIED DEALS TO ACQUISITIONS



When a lead becomes serious, update the CRM immediately.



The acquisitions process should have enough information for BTX Homes to determine:



BUY / NEGOTIATE / FOLLOW UP / PASS



8. NEGOTIATE



You will be trained on our acquisition strategy.



Your job is NOT to overpay simply to get a contract.



You must understand:



**ARV / MARKET VALUE



REPAIR COST

HOLDING COST

CLOSING COSTS

ASSIGNMENT/PROFIT MARGIN

= MAXIMUM PURCHASE PRICE**



Offers must stay within BTX Homes' approved buying criteria.



9. DAILY CRM MANAGEMENT



At the end of every workday, the CRM should clearly show:



Who you called

Who answered

Who didn't answer

Who was texted

Who needs follow-up

Seller motivation

Asking price

Offer price

Next follow-up date

Current lead status

Notes from conversation



If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.



DAILY KPI TARGETS



Initial targets:



CALLS



75–125 outbound calls/day



TEXTS



50–100 personalized/approved follow-up texts/day



FOLLOW-UPS



Every lead requiring follow-up must be contacted according to the schedule.



CONVERSATIONS



Target 10+ meaningful seller conversations/day as the pipeline develops.



QUALIFIED LEADS



Target 3–5 qualified seller opportunities/day once the lead pipeline is established.



Quality is more important than blindly hitting numbers.



WHAT MAKES A GREAT ACQUISITIONS VA?



We want someone who is:



CONFIDENT



Comfortable speaking with property owners.



PERSISTENT



Doesn't give up after one unanswered call.



ORGANIZED



Keeps every lead updated.



A GOOD LISTENER



Understands the seller instead of simply reading a script.



SALES-MINDED



Knows how to move a conversation forward.



HONEST



Never misrepresents BTX Homes.



PATIENT



Understands that some deals require weeks or months of follow-up.



EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



Experience with any of the following is a PLUS:



U.S. real estate

Real estate wholesaling

Acquisitions

Cold calling

SMS follow-up

Lead generation

Motivated seller leads

Property management

Sales

PropStream

DealMachine

XLeads

Podio

GoHighLevel

Google Sheets

CRM systems



Real estate experience is preferred but not required for the right salesperson.



TRAINING PROVIDED



You will receive an SOP covering:



How to call leads

Opening the conversation

Seller qualification

Motivation questions

Property questions

Price questions

Handling objections

Follow-up procedures

SMS procedures

CRM procedures

Offer procedures

When to escalate a lead

How to identify HOT leads

How to move a seller toward a contract

HOT LEAD RULE



If a seller says anything similar to:

description:
Position: Virtual Driving for Dollars Lead Generator

ABOUT BTX HOMES



BTX Homes LLC is a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on finding off-market properties, motivated sellers, land, and investment opportunities.



We are looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant who can help us find distressed and potentially motivated property owners without physically driving neighborhoods.



Instead, you will use online mapping, property data, satellite imagery, street imagery, and real-estate research tools to identify potential properties.



This is a lead-generation position, not a general administrative VA position.

FIND PROPERTIES → IDENTIFY DISTRESS → RESEARCH OWNER → ADD LEAD TO CRM → MOVE TO ACQUISITIONS

Bad roofs

Collect available owner information

Check property details

Determine whether the property fits BTX Homes' buying criteria

Enter qualified leads into our CRM/database

Flag the best opportunities for the acquisitions team

Google Sheets

Excel

CRM systems

Other tools provided by BTX Homes



You do NOT need experience with every tool. We will train the right person.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is:



RELIABLE

DETAIL-ORIENTED



Can identify small property details and enter information accurately.



TECH-SAVVY



Comfortable learning new websites, software, maps, and databases.



SELF-MOTIVATED



Can work independently without someone constantly watching over you.



FAST LEARNER



Can follow an SOP and improve with feedback.



REAL-ESTATE MINDED

Real estate investing

Driving for Dollars

PropStream

DealMachine

XLeads

Skip tracing

Property research

Google Maps

CRM management

Excel/Google Sheets



Real estate experience is preferred but NOT required.



We can train someone who has the right attitude and attention to detail.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We are NOT interested in someone who simply sits at a computer for 8 hours.



We measure RESULTS and ACCURACY.



Your daily activity may include:



Properties reviewed

Qualified leads created

Owner information researched

Older house + visibly damaged roof + overgrown yard + apparent vacancy + owner information verified.



BAD LEAD:

Nice-looking house with no obvious distress simply because it was easy to add.

We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support. 



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery. 



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators. 



What you’ll be doing:

title: Reverse Recruiter / U.S. Technical Job Search & Application Specialist
description:
Part-time, ongoing. Starting target: US$3.50–$5.00/hour, depending on demonstrated experience and quality. Initial hours: 8–10 hours/week; increases require approval and demonstrated value.



ABOUT THE ROLE

I am a U.S.-based telecommunications/RF/wireless engineer seeking an experienced reverse recruiter to manage a broad, high-quality professional job search. Your work will uncover strong direct-fit opportunities and credible career pivots, tailor truthful ATS-aligned resumes, submit approved applications after hire, and maintain an accurate application pipeline. Research judgment and factual integrity matter more than application volume.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Search LinkedIn, Indeed, Google, employer career sites, and other reputable sources using Boolean/X-ray searches, synonyms, adjacent job families, competitor research, and company-site searches.

• Find non-obvious opportunities beyond titles containing “RF” or “telecommunications.” Read full job descriptions and distinguish required qualifications, preferred qualifications, learnable gaps, and fatal gaps.

• Search California first, credible U.S. remote roles next, and exceptional U.S. opportunities elsewhere. Prioritize approximately $150,000+ base salary or strong total compensation for the job seeker, while considering strategically valuable roles with compelling benefits, pension, growth, or pivot potential.

• Verify that postings are open and actionable. Use official employer application links whenever available; flag alternative sources for verification.

• Classify opportunities as Direct Fit, Adjacent Growth, Strategic Stretch, or Do Not Apply and explain the evidence behind each recommendation.

• After hire, present opportunities for approval, tailor supported resumes and requested cover letters/application answers, perform quality checks, and submit only approved applications.

• Work accurately with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, and similar systems.

• Maintain a centralized Google Sheets/Excel tracker, prevent duplicates, preserve resume versions, and log submissions the same day.

• Identify relevant recruiters or hiring managers for priority applications and prepare outreach drafts for approval. Track follow-ups and outcomes.



SEARCH AREAS

Telecommunications, public-safety communications, LMR, RF/wireless, spectrum/FCC, microwave, systems engineering, integration/validation, technical project/program management, solutions/customer engineering, field applications, utilities/energy, critical infrastructure, OT/industrial communications, satellite/space and defense communications, IoT/edge/sensing, wireless hardware and semiconductor systems, and credible network/data-center/cloud/AI infrastructure pivots. Discover additional job families through research. Do not imply unsupported specialist experience.



REQUIRED SKILLS

• Demonstrated U.S. professional job-search support, reverse recruiting, recruiting, sourcing, or career-services experience; engineering/technology experience is strongly preferred.

• Strong technical job-description reading, transferable-skills analysis, Boolean/X-ray research, and employer-site sourcing.

• Excellent written English and careful factual checking.

• ATS resume tailoring without inventing experience, credentials, technologies, metrics, responsibilities, or job titles.

• Application-system experience and disciplined Google Sheets/Excel tracking.

• Ability to work independently, explain recommendations, follow written approval rules, and maintain confidentiality.

Two or more years of relevant experience and examples of client interviews generated by your work are preferred. AI tools may support research and drafting, but all output must be verified and sensitive information must remain within approved tools.



SELECTION PROCESS

1. Application review and shortlist.

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a small, unpaid 3-opportunity competency screen, explaining why each opportunity fits. This is an assessment only; no applications, employer outreach, or account access are involved.

3. Only the top 2 finalists receive a paid 20-opportunity research trial. Trial payment terms and any time cap will be agreed in writing before work begins.

4. One specialist is selected for ongoing part-time work based on research quality, technical judgment, factual integrity, communication, tracking, and cost/availability.



The paid trial includes 8 Direct Fit, 6 Adjacent Growth, 3 Strategic Stretch, and 3 Do Not Apply opportunities with reasoned explanations. At least 6 of the 20 must be credible discoveries beyond simple “RF Engineer” or “Telecommunications Engineer” searches. No applications or employer outreach may be submitted during the trial.



For each trial opportunity, record company, title, location/remote status, advertised compensation, official job URL, posting date/age and deadline when available, classification, fit score with explanation, 3–5 supported matching qualifications, learnable versus fatal gaps, career value, and recommended action. Clearly mark unavailable information.



ACCURACY, ACCESS, AND PRIVACY

The provided Master Career Record is the factual source of truth. Every major resume claim must be traceable to it or separately approved information. Ask about ambiguous experience. Do not add unsupported keywords or automatically advertise total years of experience. Employer-facing positioning and any salary expectations require approval.



The operation uses one dedicated Gmail account owned by me. Trial candidates receive no Gmail or LinkedIn access. After hire, only controlled, explicitly approved access is granted. I retain ownership, recovery methods, and security controls. Do not change credentials, recovery details, forwarding, or permissions without authorization. LinkedIn work must follow the agreed access restrictions; any account access requires separate approval.

title: E-commerce Front-End Specialist — Product Listings & Catalog (Shopify) | Full-Time
description:
About us

We are a Dutch e-commerce company running a portfolio of Shopify dropshipping stores in home & decor and fashion, selling across European and US markets with Google as our main traffic channel. Because we work with suppliers, our catalog changes constantly.



We are a small, fast-moving team. You will work directly with the founders, our supply chain contact, and our customer service team.

The role

You are the person who owns our product catalog. You build new listings for our home & decor stores, and you quality-check and correct listings for our fashion stores. You make sure every product page is accurate, well-written, searchable, and visually strong.



This is not a copy-paste job. We are looking for someone who understands why a listing performs: the right keywords in the title, clean variant structures, complete product information, and images that convert.

What you will do

Create new product listings for our home & decor stores in Shopify (titles, descriptions, specifications, variants, collections, tags)

Review and correct existing listings in our fashion stores — spot errors, weak titles, wrong sizing, broken variants, low-quality images

Do keyword research for product titles and descriptions, and apply it so our products are found in Google Shopping and organic search

Work closely with supply chain: when a supplier changes a product, discontinues a size, or updates packaging or specifications, you update the listing accordingly

Work closely with customer service: based on what comes back from customers, you add extra information to the product page (materials, fit, dimensions, care instructions, what is included) and adjust the listing where needed — for example excluding a size or variant, or replacing images

Create and maintain size charts, including updating size tables in apps such as Kiwi Size Chart

Generate and edit product images with AI tools (backgrounds, lifestyle shots, cleanups, model shots, consistent brand look)

Keep our catalog consistent across brands and markets

How we work

Short lines, clear ownership, and no unnecessary meetings. You get your own set of stores and you are responsible for the quality of what is live. We check the work, we give direct feedback, and we expect you to ask questions when something is unclear rather than guess. We read every application ourselves, so mention listing ninja somewhere in your message and we will know you got this far.

What we are looking for

Proven experience with Shopify — you know your way around products, variants, collections, metafields, apps, and the admin in general

Real e-commerce SEO experience: you understand search volume, keyword intent, and how a product title affects visibility in Google Shopping and organic search

Hands-on experience generating product images with AI tools (for example Midjourney, Flux, Photoshop AI, or similar) and basic photo editing

Experience working with AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Manus in your daily workflow — this is a requirement, not a bonus

Fluent spoken English — you will be in regular calls with us and with the team

Grammatically strong written English — our product pages sell in English-speaking markets and the copy needs to read like a native wrote it

Detail-obsessed. You notice that a size chart is in the wrong unit, that one variant is missing an image, or that a title is 20 characters too long

Comfortable communicating with different departments

Able to work full-time (40 hours/week) with a solid daily overlap with our office hours in the Netherlands (CET)

A stable, fast internet connection and a working backup plan for power outages or internet failure (generator, UPS, mobile hotspot, or a second location). This is important to us — we need to be able to count on your availability

A computer that can handle image work

Must have

Experience in dropshipping or supplier-based e-commerce

Experience working with multiple stores or multiple markets/languages

Experience with Gorgias or another helpdesk tool

What we offer

A full-time, long-term position — we are looking for someone to grow with us, not for a one-off project

Direct contact with the founders and short decision lines

Real ownership of the catalog across a growing brand portfolio

Room to bring your own ideas about how we list, photograph, and optimize products

Paid time off and yearly reviews

How to apply

Send us:



A Loom video of maximum 3–4 minutes in which you introduce yourself and walk us through your e-commerce experience. Please speak English in the video — we want to hear how you communicate

Which Shopify stores you have worked on (links if possible)

2–3 examples of product listings you created or improved, and what changed as a result

Examples of product images you generated or edited with AI

Which AI tools you use and what you use them for

Your availability and how many hours of overlap with CET you can offer



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Rental Business Operations VA — WooCommerce, Lead Gen & Customer Support (Australian industrial company)
description:
About us



We are InstroEX, an instrumentation, electrical and hazardous areas (EEHA) contracting business in Perth, Western Australia. We work with oil & gas, mining, power generation, water treatment and petrochemical clients.



We are launching a new arm of the business: renting out test and calibration equipment to those industries. The equipment is bought, the website exists, and the catalogue is part-built. We need one capable person to help finish the setup and then run the day-to-day.



This is not a data-entry job. It is a build-it-then-run-it role. If you do it well you will own the operations side of a growing business.







What you will do



1. Get the rental catalogue online



Load and maintain product listings in WordPress / WooCommerce — titles, descriptions, specs, pricing, categories, tags

Match, rename, resize and upload product images to a consistent naming standard

Keep the master inventory spreadsheet clean and matched to what is live on the site

Flag missing or unclear information rather than guessing — we will not accept invented specifications



2. Work with our SEO and web developer



We already have a contractor handling SEO and website development. You are not doing the SEO. You are the person who keeps him moving:



Attend the weekly call, take the actions, and report back to me in plain English

Give him what he needs on time — product lists, copy, images, access, answers

Chase outstanding items and keep a running list of what is done and what is not

Check his work actually went live and looks right on the site, and raise it when it does not



3. Lead generation



Build and maintain prospect lists of maintenance, reliability, projects and procurement people at industrial sites in WA

Run outreach by
 and LinkedIn, follow up properly, and keep the CRM up to date

Qualify inbound enquiries and turn them into quote requests



4. Phone and customer contact



Answer the rental enquiry line and speak with Australian clients

Call prospects and existing customers, follow up quotes, confirm bookings and returns

You need to be confident and clear on the phone with technical trade and engineering people



5. Day-to-day operations



Prepare quotes and rental agreements, raise invoices in Xero

Track equipment out, equipment back, calibration dates and asset records

Keep our processes documented so the business runs the same way every time





What we need from you



3+ years as a VA, e-commerce assistant or operations assistant

Real hands-on WooCommerce experience — you have loaded and managed product listings yourself, not just watched someone do it

Excellent spoken and written English. Clear on the phone with Australian accents

You chase things. If a contractor or supplier owes us something, you follow it up without being reminded

Reliable internet, a quiet space to take calls, and a working headset

Accurate and detail-focused. In our industry a wrong number on a spec sheet is a real problem

Able to work independently once you know the job, and honest enough to say "I do not know" instead of guessing



Bonus points



Experience in equipment rental, hire, industrial supply, mining services or trades

Familiarity with test and calibration instruments (pressure calibrators, multimeters, gas detectors, loop calibrators)

Experience working with Australian businesses







How to apply



Applications that do not follow these steps will not be read.





Send a link to a WooCommerce store you have worked on, and tell me exactly what you did on it.

Answer these in your message (short answers are fine):

How many products have you personally loaded into WooCommerce?

Tell me your favorite ice cream in the first line of you responce!

Tell me about a time you had to chase a contractor, supplier or colleague to get something delivered. What did you do?

Describe one time you generated a lead or a sale for an employer.

How comfortable are you calling a stranger at a mine site to follow up a quote? Rate 1–10 and say why.

What is your monthly rate expectation?

Record a 60–90 second voice or video message introducing yourself in English, as if you were leaving a voi
 for a customer whose rental is due back tomorrow. Send the link.



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a small trial task before we make an offer.

description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1200 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Experienced AI Video Creator & Editor (full-time, long-term)
description:
Read this first: if you do not already have real experience creating videos with AI, and you cannot already edit at a professional level, do not apply. You will not get a reply. This is not a role you learn on the job.



THE WORK



We're a DACH-facing (German) jewelry e-commerce brand looking for a creative video editor who can produce high-converting video content — mainly AI-generated UGC and animation, but capable of all sorts of creative formats across multiple platforms.



I give you the brief: the concept, the angle, what the video has to do. You do the rest — write the prompts, run the generations, judge what comes back, and cut it into a finished video. I do not hand you prompts to paste in, and I do not teach the tools.



Both halves matter equally. Generation is the harder one: getting a specific shot out of a model takes the right prompt, the right references and real judgement. Editing is the one people underestimate — CapCut is easy to open, but pacing, timing, sound and a hook that holds someone for two seconds are not.



We pay for the tools and every credit you use on the job. We are not tied to one platform, so I want someone comfortable moving between models.



MUST HAVE — ALL OF IT



Provable experience generating video with AI (Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Hailuo — as long as you personally made the work and can explain how)

You write your own prompts from a brief. This is the single most important requirement here.

Efficiency. Regenerating is normal; needing thirty attempts is not. I expect a usable shot within a few generations.

Strong editing: CapCut at a level where it is not your bottleneck, plus a real sense for pacing and sound

Fluent, natural English, written and spoken

A portfolio of short-form video you made yourself

Reliable internet and a computer that handles video work



Nice to have: jewelry, fashion or beauty experience (genuinely optional), Meta and TikTok ad creatives, AI image generation, After Effects, sound design.



HOURS



Full-time, 40 hours minimum. If you can do 50, I want that, and I pay for every hour.



Part of your day is yours to arrange freely. Part of it is not: I work in Central European Time and need you online during a meaningful stretch of my day, so feedback does not take 24 hours to travel. My schedule shifts sometimes and I need you flexible enough to shift with it — always with advance notice.



One person, one brand, not five clients at once. Long-term.



PAY



$5 per hour on average, up to $7. Your starting rate is set after the test pieces, and I tell you the number and the reason. After that it is reviewed monthly on the quality and volume of what you deliver: strong work moves it up, weak work moves it down. No hidden metrics.



$7 is the ceiling for the role as written. Above that there is a path to $9 as you take on more ownership of the content — d
 what gets made, not just making it.



This is an early-stage brand: no revenue yet, no proven funnel, no brand recognition. I would rather pay properly for someone who needs no supervision than pay little for work I have to fix. If you want to clock in, execute exactly, and clock out, this is not the right role.



THE TEST



Two short test videos before anyone is hired: one UGC-style, one animated. I send the briefs; you arrange your own tool access and credits for the test. Once hired, we will pay you for the credits used. 



That is a deliberate filter. Anyone chasing quick cash will not do it. If it is a dealbreaker, do not apply — no hard feelings. The test pieces are used to evaluate you and nothing else; they do not run as ads.



After the test: a paid trial project at your full rate, then the ongoing role.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not reply here. I do not read messages on this platform. Everything goes through one form:







Have ready: a portfolio link with your top 10 to 15 pieces (publicly viewable — if it does not open, the application is discarded), one prompt you wrote yourself in full next to the shot it produced, the hours you can work in CET, and a 60-second voice message in English.



The form asks for a word written in capitals in this post. It is GOLDFISH.



I reply to everyone who completes the form properly.

title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-commerce - Dropshipping)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce company selling Health, Beauty, and Supplement products across multiple international markets.



We launch and test new products every day through Meta Ads and aggressively scale the winners.



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who understands DTC, buyer psychology, funnels, and winning creatives.



This is not a graphic designer position.



This is not a social media manager position.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the creative process and help us find, develop, and scale more winning products.



Your Main Goal:

- Your main goal is to help us find more winning creatives and winning funnels, then create new variations that allow us to scale successful products.

- You will be responsible for helping us identify winning products, winning creatives, and winning funnels, then scaling them through creative iteration and optimization.



Success in this role means:

- More winning creatives

- Better-performing funnels

- Longer-lasting creatives

- Better launch performance

- More products successfully scaled



What You Will Do:

- Create creative briefs for graphic designers and video editors

- Create funnel briefs for funnel builders

- Assign tasks and manage daily workflow

- Review completed work and provide feedback

- Approve creatives and funnels before launch

- Research competitors, winning products, funnels, and ads

- Analyze why winning ads work

- Find new angles, hooks, and concepts

- Create variations of winning creatives and funnels

- Work closely with Meta Ads feedback and performance data

- Identify what should be improved next

- Help improve the overall creative workflow and team performance



You will directly work with and manage a small creative team consisting of graphic designers, video editors, and funnel builders.



Requirements - Must Have:

- Proven DTC Dropshipping experience working with 7-figure per year stores or brands.

- Health, Beauty, or Supplement experience

- Experience creating creative briefs

- Experience creating funnel briefs

- Understanding of Meta Ads metrics

- Understanding of buyer psychology

- Understanding of direct response marketing

- Experience working with graphic designers and funnel builders

- Strong English communication skills



You must understand the complete customer journey:



Ad ? Advertorial ? Landing Page ? Checkout



Not just the ad creative itself.



Nice To Have:

- Experience managing remote teams

- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Manus, Midjourney, Higgsfield, etc.

- Experience scaling winning products

- Experience working with international markets



We Are NOT Looking For

- Social Media Managers

- Canva Designers

- Brand Designers

- Agency Account Managers

- People without DTC experience

- People focused only on aesthetics



We are not looking for someone who only creates beautiful creatives.



We are looking for someone who understands performance marketing and makes decisions based on results and data.



Hiring Process:

- Application Review

- Test Task (Mandatory)

- Interview Call

- Trial Period

- Long-Term Position



Every candidate must complete a test task.



We do not hire based on portfolios alone.



Compensation:

- Compensation depends on experience, contribution, and results.

- The role includes performance-based bonuses tied to company growth, winning creatives, and successful product winners.



To Apply:



Please answer the following questions:

- How many years of DTC experience do you have?

- Which Health, Beauty, or Supplement products have you worked on?

- Have you created creative briefs and funnel briefs before?

- Have you managed graphic designers, video editors, or funnel builders?

- What was your most successful product or campaign?

- Describe a winning creative or funnel that you helped scale. Why do you think it worked?

- What AI tools do you currently use in your workflow?



Start your application with the word:



''WINNER''



Applications without this word will be ignored.

title: Inbound Sales Representative (Healthcare SaaS – US/Canada Clients | Graveyard Shift)
description:
Company: Call Hero Technologies Inc.

Location: Burnaby, Canada

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 12:00 AM–8:00 AM Manila time

Salary: Php80,000–Php100,000/month base + uncapped commission (OTE: Php80,000–Php150,000)



!!! IMPORTANT !!!

Please read the entire job post carefully before applying. There are specific application instructions at the bottom, and applications that do not follow them will not be considered.



Please also complete the Google Form and attach your updated resume as part of your application. 





About the Schedule



The shift is 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That's 9am–5pm in Vancouver, Canada, where we're based.

This is a permanent work from home and  graveyard schedule, not a rotating one. If that doesn't work for your life, please don't apply — we'd rather you skip this than quit in two months.



!! About Call Hero



Call Hero is a fast-growing SaaS company based in Canada. We build AI-powered communication tools that help healthcare clinics improve the way they manage patient calls, appointments, and front desk operations.



Our customers include physical therapy clinics, chiropractic offices, dental practices, and other healthcare providers. Our mission is simple: help clinics deliver a better patient experience while increasing bookings and reducing missed opportunities.



!! The Role



You are not cold calling. You'll work warm inbound: people who have booked a demo, started a trial, missed a scheduled call, or gone quiet.



Your job is to get on the phone with a clinic owner, understand how their practice actually runs, show them what we do, and close them. You will spend at least 4 hours a day on the phone. The rest is CRM notes, follow-up, and prep.



This is NOT a virtual assistant job. No admin, data entry, design, or social media. If you don't genuinely enjoy talking to people on the phone, this role will make you miserable and we'd both regret it.



??What You'll Do



> Run scheduled demo calls with clinic owners in Canada, the US, and Australia

> Follow up with trial users and no-shows until you get a decision either way

> Handle objections about price, timing, and existing phone systems

> Keep your pipeline clean in our CRM — every call logged, every next step dated

> Hit a monthly closed-deal target



?? What We're Looking For



> At least 2 years of phone sales experience carrying a real quota. Customer support alone is not enough.

> Experience with North American customers, preferably in a BPO or similar environment

> Excellent, natural spoken English with a neutral or North American accent. You'll be speaking with clinic owners who need   to feel they're talking to a colleague.

> Proven graveyard shift experience — tell us how long you did it

> Comfortable handling objections and closing, not just presenting

> A real headset and stable wired internet (25 Mbps+)

> Coachable. We record calls and review them together weekly.



!! Nice to Have



> Any healthcare background — our customers are clinicians, and speaking their language helps enormously

> Experience selling software or a subscription product

> Any background where you've been trained on how you sound



** Compensation

Php80,000–Php100,000 per month guaranteed base depending on experience, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close.



On-target earnings are Php80,000–Php150,000; the top of that range is what a strong closer actually earns hitting target, not a ceiling.



You'll also receive paid training, weekly coaching on your recorded calls, and a long-term full-time seat on a small team where you'll talk to the founder directly.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (Send all completed application requirements to: 



Applications missing any of these five items will not be opened. This is not a soft preference.



1. Subject Line



Write the name of the city we're based in, then a dash, then the minimum number of hours per day you'd spend on the phone in this role. Both are stated above.



Format example: Toronto - 6



2. Send the Link to Your 2-Minute Audio Recording



Please send us the link to your 2-minute audio recording covering the 3 parts below. You can use Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. (Three parts, about 2 minutes total)



-> We don't need a video, just the audio. We want to hear how you sound. Please make sure to check the sharing settings so we can actually open the recording.



 Part A : Read this out loud, exactly as written:



 "Hi, this is [your name] from Call Hero. Thanks for booking time with me. Before we jump into the demo, I want to make     sure I understand your clinic. How many physiotherapists do you have on staff right now, and roughly how many calls does your front desk field on a busy Monday? The reason I ask is that most clinics we work with are losing five to fifteen bookable calls a week without realizing it — voi
s nobody returns, people who hang up after four rings, patients calling at seven in the evening when everyone's already gone home. Our system picks those up. It's about a two-week setup, and you'd keep your existing numbers."



Part B: NO SCRIPT for this one



You're live on a call and the clinic owner says:



 "We already have a phone system through our practice software and honestly it works fine. What makes yours different?" 



(respond the way you actually would on the phone. Don't write it out first, just talk. We're listening for how you think, not for a perfect answer.)



Part C:  At the end, say today's date out loud and the phrase "for Call Hero."



3. Answer These Three Questions below: (short answers preferred)



       a. Have you worked a graveyard shift before, and for how long?



       b. Go to 
. In one sentence: what do you think we do, and who is our customer?



       c. Tell us about a sale you lost. What happened, and what you'd do differently.



4. Your Desired Monthly Rate in Pesos: A specific number. "Negotiable" or "up to you" gets rejected.



5. One Line on Your Phone Background: Where you sold, what you sold, what your target was.

title: AI Static Ad Designer — DTC Paid Social (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
US supplement brand. We run paid ads on Meta every single day.



We are looking for someone who produces static ads at volume using AI. Not a graphic designer. Not a creative strategist.



We come up with the concepts. You turn them into images.





WHAT YOU'D DO



Take a winning ad and make fifty versions of it. Same message, fifty different ways. Different hooks, different layouts, different colours, different angles.



Take a new concept we hand you and design it. We give you the idea, the script and a reference. You d
 what it looks like.



Build offer ads. Buy one get one, percentage off, free gift stacks, price comparisons. Same template, one thing changed each time.



You will be producing hundreds of images a month. Nobody hand-designs that. You need to be working in AI.





THE TOOLS YOU NEED TO ALREADY KNOW



Nano Banana Pro

Midjourney

Higgsfield

Photoshop or Figma for assembly



We pay for all of these. We are not teaching you how to use them.





WHO THIS IS FOR



You generate images, you don't build everything by hand.



You've made ads that actually ran on paid traffic. Not brand work. Not logos. Not social media posts.



You can take one idea and produce twenty versions of it without getting bored or getting clever.



You follow the brief. If we say the same message five ways, you don't give us five different messages.



You have taste but you don't need to prove it. The ad is not your portfolio piece.





DO NOT APPLY IF



You mainly do branding, logos, or social media content.



You have never made an ad that ran on paid Meta traffic.



You want to come up with the concepts. We do that part.



You are still learning AI image tools.





THE SETUP



Full time. Long term. Remote.



Work your own hours as long as deadlines are hit and you're responsive during agreed windows.



We provide every tool and pay for all credits.



Base pay plus a bonus on every ad of yours that scales.





HOW TO APPLY



We are not reading CVs and we do not want a portfolio.



We want you to make something.



Reply and we will send you one of our ads that is currently working, plus one line of direction. You will have 48 hours to send us five versions of it.



That is the whole application. Whoever sends the best five gets a call.

title: Commercial Furniture Designer (CET Designer)
description:
About the Opportunity

We're hiring on behalf of an established U.S. commercial interiors company. Their design and sales teams deliver real commercial workplace projects across the U.S., including offices, collaboration spaces, and full workplace fit-outs.



The Role

You'll be an extension of the internal design team. Day to day, you'll be working in CET Designer to produce space plans, specifications, and presentation materials that go straight to clients and installers. Some days you'll own a small project end to end. Other days you'll be supporting senior designers with rendering and presentation work on larger projects.

This is technical, accuracy-driven design work, the kind where a wrong part number or a missed clearance becomes a real problem on the install floor. If you take pride in clean, buildable, error-free drawing sets, you'll do well here.



What You'll Do

Develop space plans and furniture layouts in CET Designer

Take on small design projects independently, from initial layout through final documentation

Specify commercial furniture products, finishes, and accessories

Support internal designers with renderings, presentation boards, and client-facing visuals

Produce client proposals, bills of materials, validation packages, and installation drawings

Review specifications for accuracy, completeness, clearances, product application, and installation requirements

Revise projects based on feedback from Sales, Design, clients, and manufacturers

Maintain organized project files and follow established drawing, documentation, and quality-control standards

Communicate proactively with the U.S. team on priorities, deadlines, questions, and project status

Manage multiple projects at once and consistently hit deadlines



What We're Looking For



Required

Degree in interior design, architecture, or a related field, with a portfolio you can share

3 to 5 years of professional design experience

Completed CET Designer training and comfortable working in CET day to day

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft 365

Strong written English and clear, proactive communication

Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team

Reliable computer and internet setup capable of running CET Designer smoothly

Availability for consistent working-hour overlap with the U.S. team



Preferred

Experience with commercial interiors, contract furniture, space planning, or furniture specification

Familiarity with manufacturer-specific CET extensions (Steelcase, MillerKnoll, Haworth, Teknion, Kimball, etc.)

Experience producing SIF files, BOMs, or dealer-side documentation

Working knowledge of ADA and life-safety clearance requirements



Who Succeeds Here

A dependable, technically capable designer who is receptive to feedback and committed to producing accurate, installation-ready work. You ask questions early rather than guessing, you double-check your own specs before they go out, and you keep the team in the loop without being chased for updates.



What's Offered

Full-time, long-term role with a growing U.S. commercial interiors company

Real project ownership, not just production support

Direct collaboration with an experienced U.S. design and sales team

Exposure to major commercial furniture brands and current workplace design standards

Negotiable rate for candidates with strong CET experience



How to Apply

All applications must be submitted through our application form:



Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



Before you start, have the following ready:

Your resume/CV

Your design portfolio (PDF or link, such as Google Drive, Behance, or a personal site)

Which CET Designer extensions you've worked in, and how long you've used CET

A short description of a commercial project you specified or space-planned, and your role in it

Your working-hours availability relative to U.S. Pacific Time

Your expected hourly rate

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to schedule an interview with the team.

title: US‑Market Building Material Lead Research & Outreach Specialist
description:
This remote role is to identify, qualify and outreach US‑based commercial buyers who are motivated to cut material costs by sourcing directly from Asia.



Target prospects are US builders, real‑estate developers, building material dealers & general contractors, who currently purchase cabinets, stone countertops, such or other parts from local US distributors at high cost, and are open to FOB China factory direct supply for large‑volume multifamily & commercial projects.



You will filter out pure retail‑focused stores, and only deliver qualified project‑oriented business leads. You are not doing end‑to‑end sales; your output is well‑vetted lead lists and initial qualification feedback for our internal sales team.



 Key Responsibilities



1. Research and prospect US building‑material‑related companies via Google Business Profiles, LinkedIn, industry association directories, builder association lists,
/Instagram business pages, and trade‑show exhibitor records.

2. Screen prospects against clear qualification criteria: confirm their business scope, typical project volume, current sourcing channels, and their willingness to explore China factory direct sourcing for cost reduction.

3. Conduct short outbound outreach 
 / LinkedIn message) to pre‑qualify prospects; verify whether they accept FOB China terms for bulk project orders.

4. Compile structured lead spreadsheet daily: company name, city‑state, decision‑maker name & title, contact info, website, main product lines, typical project type & volume, current sourcing notes, cooperation interest level (High / Medium / Low).

5. Exclude retail‑only shops, small residential remodel contractors without multi‑family / commercial project scale.

6. Submit daily lead deliverables and brief weekly progress report: number of researched companies, qualified valid leads, number of contacts reached, high‑interest prospects summary.



## Ideal Target Client Profile (Must follow)



- US‑based builders, multifamily developers, commercial interior dealers, general contractors

- Mainly working on multi‑family apartments, townhome communities or commercial construction projects

- Currently buying interior materials (cabinet, quartz countertop, flooring) from domestic US distributors with relatively high material cost

- Have stable bulk‑order project pipeline, and are actively seeking cost‑down solutions

This is a hands-on role that combines digital creativity with practical organisation. You will take ownership of our social media channels while also supporting industry events, marketing campaigns, and day-to-day marketing operations.

As a biophilic design company, a genuine enthusiasm for plants, interior design, and emerging design trends would be highly beneficial. Our clients include designers, architects, and fit-out companies, so an interest in the creative and commercial design world is important.

title: Miscellaneous Steel Estimator
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Steel Estimator with experience in miscellaneous and structural steel fabrication. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with precision, and can confidently manage multiple estimating projects from takeoff through bid preparation.



This is a part-time opportunity, perfect for an experienced estimator looking for flexible work while contributing to high-impact projects.



Core Responsibilities



Estimating & Project Analysis



• Analyze blueprints, specifications, contract documents, and project requirements to determine labor, material, and timeline needs. 

• Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for miscellaneous and structural steel projects, including stairs, railings, tanks, hoppers, chutes, and other fabricated steel components. 

• Prepare accurate cost estimates, bid proposals, and scopes of work. 

• Review project documents to identify potential risks, exclusions, and conditions that may impact project scope and pricing. 

• Develop value-engineered solutions and cost-saving recommendations where appropriate. 



Project Coordination & Documentation



• Manage drawing reviews and submittals from internal review through fabrication release. 

• Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors to obtain complete and competitive pricing. 

• Maintain estimating databases, bid records, and project documentation. 

• Support proposal development and business growth initiatives through accurate and timely estimating. 



Required Qualifications & Skills



• Minimum of 5 years of experience in miscellaneous metals and/or structural steel estimating. 

• Strong ability to perform accurate quantity takeoffs and material takeoffs. 

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents. 

• Strong understanding of general conditions and project requirements that may impact scope, scheduling, and pricing. 

• Experience using estimating software, Bluebeam, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Word. 

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and time management skills. 

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to estimate accuracy. 

• Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously. 



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience using Tekla EPM, Tekla Estimating, Tekla PowerFab Estimating, or Tekla Modeling. 

• Experience working with parametric assemblies within Tekla estimating environments. 

• Familiarity with industry standards including AISC, AWS, NOMMA, AESS, and SSPC. 

• Experience with complex, custom, or large-scale steel fabrication projects. 

• Background in value engineering and cost optimization strategies. 

• Strong collaboration skills working with fabrication teams, project managers, vendors, and subcontractors. 



Work Schedule



• Part-Time 

• CST Time Zone 

• Flexible working arrangement based on project workload 



Why This Role Matters



This position plays a critical role in ensuring accurate project costing, competitive bids, and profitable project execution. Your expertise will directly contribute to the success of fabrication projects while supporting the company's growth and long-term client relationships.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit:



• Updated Resume 

• A 60–90 second self-introduction video sharing your estimating experience and why you are a great fit for this role 

• Samples of previous work (takeoffs, estimates, bid packages, etc. — please remove or redact any confidential information) 



Note: Only applications submitted within 48–72 hours of this posting will be considered.

title: Customs Data Research & Import‑Buyer Matching Analyst
description:
This remote analyst role focuses on processing US customs import records You will review historical US import shipment data, identify real‑life importers, analyze their import product categories, and validate how well their past import history matches our target product portfolio: kitchen cabinets, quartz / stone countertops, interior flooring for multifamily construction projects.



You will clean raw customs datasets, filter irrelevant importers, mark matching‑level for each company, and deliver structured, verified lead spreadsheets. No outbound sales or customer messaging required**. This is purely data research, cross‑checking and qualification work.



## Key Responsibilities



1. Work with provided US customs raw datasets (bill‑of‑lading records). Extract key fields: importer company name, location (US city & state), supplier origin, shipped product description, shipment volume, shipment date.

2. Analyze each importer’s historical import records: judge what types of building‑material goods they have previously imported.

3. Conduct secondary cross‑verification via Google / company website / LinkedIn: confirm the importer’s real‑world business type (builder / dealer / distributor / general contractor / retailer).

4. Grade each importer by product‑match level: **High Match / Medium Match / Low Match / Not Qualified**.

   - High Match: Has prior import history of cabinets, stone countertops, flooring; operates as project‑oriented commercial buyer for multifamily / commercial projects.

   - Medium Match: Imports related building materials but limited track‑record on our core SKUs; worth further review.

   - Low Match / Not Qualified: Pure retail, unrelated merchandise, small‑size remodel shops, non‑construction businesses — exclude these from final output.

5. Populate standardized Excel spreadsheet with all verified information: company name, location, customs‑record product details, website, business profile, match rating, brief remarks for why it is qualified or disqualified.

6. Remove duplicate company entries from customs data. Consolidate multiple shipment records belonging to the same importer.

7. Submit daily updated spreadsheet and short weekly summary: total records processed, number of high‑match qualified importers filtered out.



## Qualified Importer Profile (Reference for your checking)



- US‑based importers with past import records of cabinetry, stone countertops, flooring or related interior construction materials

- Business type: building‑material dealer, wholesale distributor, multifamily builder, real‑estate developer, general contractor

- Prior ocean‑import experience (familiar with overseas FOB sourcing)

- Exclude: e‑commerce resellers with small parcel shipments, pure retail stores, non‑construction‑related importers.
