title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo
/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end
 & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted
 & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for
 & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

Experience with New Zealand payroll or Employment Hero HR implementations would be an added advantage but is not essential.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Australian payroll processing and support:



Process and review end-to-end Australian payrolls accurately and within required deadlines.

Review timesheets, employee changes, leave, allowances, deductions, superannuation and termination payments.

Complete payroll reconciliations, variance checks and payroll reporting.

Investigate discrepancies and resolve payroll processing or system configuration issues.

Respond professionally to client queries and clearly explain identified issues and required actions.

Identify and report payroll, compliance, data and system risks.

Maintain accurate records and protect confidential payroll information.

Manage work across multiple clients while meeting competing deadlines.



Employment Hero Payroll implementations:



Assist with and progressively manage Employment Hero Payroll implementations.

Configure businesses, pay schedules, pay categories, leave categories, allowances, deductions, superannuation and other payroll settings.

Configure and test pay rate templates, work types, rule sets, tags and employment conditions.

Assist with award and enterprise agreement configuration.

Prepare and validate employee uploads, opening balances and historical earnings data.

Support general ledger mapping and integrations with HR, accounting and time-and-attendance systems.

Perform system testing, user acceptance testing and parallel payroll comparisons.

Investigate and resolve variances identified during testing.

Prepare procedures, testing records, implementation documentation and client guides.

Assist with client training, handover and post-implementation support.



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE



You must have:



At least four to five years of hands-on Australian payroll experience.

Advanced practical knowledge of Employment Hero Payroll, formerly KeyPay.

Demonstrated Employment Hero Payroll implementation and configuration experience.

Experience processing Australian payroll from end to end—not only payroll administration or data entry.

Strong knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including Fair Work, modern awards, enterprise agreements, PAYG withholding, STP, superannuation, leave and termination payments.

Experience interpreting modern awards, enterprise agreements or other complex payroll conditions.

Strong reconciliation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.

Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate work.

The ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet strict deadlines.

A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and a secure, private home workspace.



HIGHLY REGARDED



The following experience would be an advantage:



New Zealand payroll processing or implementation experience.

Employment Hero HR implementation or administration.

Managed or outsourced payroll experience across multiple clients.

Complex award and enterprise agreement rule configuration.

Payroll compliance reviews, audits or remediation calculations.

General ledger mapping and accounting-system integrations.

Preparing client guides, procedures and training materials.



ABOUT YOU



You are someone who:



Takes ownership of their work and follows issues through to resolution.

Understands that payroll accuracy requires investigation and professional judgement—not simply following a checklist.

Recognises incomplete or inconsistent information and asks questions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

Can work independently while keeping others informed of progress, issues and risks.

Is organised, dependable and comfortable managing several priorities.

Communicates professionally and confidently with clients.

Enjoys improving payroll systems, documentation and processes.

Is seeking a stable, long-term role where they can become a trusted member of the team.



CONTRACTOR ARRANGEMENT

HOW TO APPLY

If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Sr. Financial Planner Associate
description:
Description:

We are seeking a Senior Financial Planning Associate with expertise in paraplanning, SOA (Statement of Advice) preparation, and financial compliance. This role involves preparing SOAs using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic, supporting financial planners in research and analysis, and handling administrative and associate duties when not actively engaged in SOA preparation. The ideal candidate must be experienced in Australian financial planning regulations and capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.



Qualifications:

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in Australian financial planning or a related field.

- Strong understanding of superannuation, SMSF, investment strategies, and financial compliance.

- Expertise in SOA preparation using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic.

- Proficiency in XPLAN, AdviserLogic, Salesforce, and financial modeling tools is a plus.

- Experience with Statement of Advice (SOA), compliance policies, and financial planning documentation.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, work under deadlines, and adapt to changing client needs.

- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication and organizational skills to support financial planners and clients.

- Experience handling complex financial planning tasks and client portfolios.



Responsibilities:

1. Client Communication & Consultation

a. Prepare comprehensive SOAs using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic in accordance with ASIC and AFSL regulations.

b. Conduct research on investment strategies, insurance products, superannuation options, and tax structures.

c. Ensure accuracy, compliance, and clarity in all SOAs before presenting them to clients.

d. Assist financial planners in gathering client information and setting financial goals.

e. Act as a liaison between clients, financial planners, and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth communication.

f. Schedule client meetings and respond to general inquiries related to financial planning.



2. Financial Data Analysis & Research

q. Analyze client financial data and create reports, charts, and models for planning decisions.

b. Conduct research on investment products, superannuation, insurance, and tax strategies to support advisors.

c. Assist in structuring financial plans aligned with clients' needs.



3. Compliance & Documentation

a. Ensure compliance with ASIC, AFSL, and other Australian financial regulations.

b. Assist in the preparation and organization of regulatory compliance forms, investment proposals, and financial plans.

c. Manage digital documentation and agreements using DocuSign.



4. Financial Planning Software & CRM Management

a. Utilize XPLAN, AdviserLogic, Salesforce, and financial modeling tools for client records and financial projections.

b. Maintain and update client data in Creatio CRM to streamline financial planning workflows.

c.  Support financial planners in optimizing CRM usage for client management.



5. Investment & Wealth Management Support

a. Provide insights on investment strategies, tax planning, and superannuation management.

b. Assist in managing Self-Managed Super Funds (SMSF) and other wealth-building strategies.

c. Monitor and update clients on their investment performance and market trends.



6. Administrative & Process Support

a. Handle administrative tasks such as client record maintenance, meeting scheduling, and correspondence.

b. Coordinate with accountants, tax advisors, and legal teams for a holistic financial planning approach.

c. Provide administrative assistance when not actively engaged in SOA preparation.

d. Assist with client onboarding, documentation processing, and appointment coordination.

e. Identify workflow improvements and contribute to process automation initiatives.

f. Required for creating financial projections and client reports.



7. Continuous Learning & Professional Growth

a. Stay updated on Australian financial regulations, taxation laws, and market trends.

b. Participate in training programs and professional development activities.

title: Financial Planning Practice Manger
description:
Description:

This is not a traditional practice manager role. Yes, you will own the day-to-day operations of a busy financial services practice, but you will also have a genuine mandate to rethink how we work. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable optimising a compliance workflow as they are experimenting with AI tools to reduce manual effort and increase team capacity.



Qualifications:

* 2+ years' experience in a Practice Manager, Senior Paraplanner, or Senior Financial Planning Assistant role within a financial planning practice.

* Strong working knowledge of Xplan (and ideally Worksorted/Marloo/RetireMap) and demonstrated ability to optimise platform usage.

* Genuine enthusiasm for technology and AI - you actively seek out tools that make work smarter, and you can bring a team along with you.

* Solid understanding of the Australian financial planning regulatory environment, including SOA/ROA preparation, FDS obligations, and AFSL compliance frameworks.

* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities without dropping the ball.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication - you interact with clients and external stakeholders directly.

* A proactive, ownership mindset - you see problems before they become issues, and you fix them.



Highly Regarded

* Hands-on experience implementing AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a professional services context.

* Exposure to SMSF and/or complex multi-strategy advice environments.

* Experience managing loan administration workflows end-to-end in a mortgage broking context.

* Experience in a multi-disciplinary firm (financial planning + mortgage broking).



Responsibilities:



Operations & Compliance

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the financial planning and mortgage broking practice, ensuring efficient and compliant service delivery.

* Oversee client onboarding, file management, and documentation to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance across all advice and lending workflows.

* Oversee and be actively involved in the preparation, review, and finalised Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs), ensuring all documentation meets AFSL and regulatory standards.

* Ensure adherence to all licensing, compliance, and FDS/review obligations, and liaise with the AFSL and external compliance consultants as needed.

* Conduct monthly revenue reporting and KPI tracking to support strategic decision-making by the Principal.

* Supervise and support administrative and support staff, including workload management, training, and performance feedback.



Technology & Innovation

* Own the firm's technology stack - actively evaluate, implement, and optimise tools to improve efficiency and scalability across all service lines.

* Lead the integration and adoption of AI tools (e.g., Marloo etc) to automate repeatable tasks, improve document quality, and reduce manual effort across the advice and lending workflows.

* Administer and continuously improve our core platforms: Xplan, Worksorted, and Marloo, ensuring they are configured to support best practice workflows.

* Identify opportunities to automate client communications, data entry, compliance tracking, and reporting through integration of best-of-breed tools.

* Develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for key workflows, enabling consistent delivery as the team grows.

* Stay current with emerging fintech and AI developments relevant to financial planning and mortgage broking, and bring recommendations to the Principal.



Client & Business Development

* Liaise with clients in a professional and empathetic manner to support the delivery of a high-quality client experience.

* Assist with client engagement initiatives, marketing efforts, and new business workflows to support practice growth.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders including lenders, platform providers, software vendors, and product providers.

title: Google & YouTube Ads Specialist (Ecommerce Brand)
description:
Are YOU an experienced Google Ads specialist who knows how to build a Search Brand Protection campaign that actually stops competitors and resellers from hijacking your branded traffic? Can you look at a broken conversion tracking setup and immediately spot where the pixel is leaking data? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run Sashiko, an international ecommerce brand, and we're looking for a Google Ads Specialist to take ownership of our Search and YouTube advertising.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



Search Brand Protection, Done Right: We already launched a Brand Protection Search campaign ourselves and it did not work. You will audit what went wrong (keyword selection, match types, negative keywords, competitor bidding on our brand terms) and rebuild it into a campaign that actually defends our branded traffic.



YouTube Ads, From Zero: We have never run YouTube Ads. You will plan, structure, and launch our first YouTube campaigns — audience targeting, ad formats, creative testing cadence — and own their ongoing optimization.



Performance Max Evaluation: Assess whether PMax is a fit for our catalog and goals, and if so, structure and launch it correctly (asset groups, signals, exclusions) rather than treating it as a "set and forget" black box.



Tracking & Pixel Audit: We suspect our tracking has gaps. You will audit our Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 setup, and pixel implementation, identify where data is being lost or misattributed, and fix it.



Weekly Performance Review: A short weekly check-in to walk us through results, what changed, and what's next. This is not a "launch and disappear" engagement — we want to actually see the numbers move.



Position Requirements:



At least 2-3 years of specific experience running Google Ads and YouTube Ads for ecommerce brands. You must be able to show real account results, not just certifications.



Strong technical grounding in tracking: comfortable diagnosing conversion tracking issues, GA4 configuration, and pixel/tag implementation problems — this is a recurring pain point for us and a core reason we're hiring.



Hands-on Search campaign expertise, specifically keyword strategy for brand protection / defensive campaigns — this is not generic "grow your Search account" work.



Judgment on PMax, not blind enthusiasm for it: we want someone who can tell us honestly whether it's the right tool for a given goal.



Clear, proactive communication: you flag problems and propose fixes without needing to be chased.



Availability: This is a part-time, ongoing collaboration — a few hours per week for campaign management and one weekly review call. This is not a full-time role, but we are looking for someone reliable who stays engaged month over month, not a one-off project.



What We Offer:



Ongoing Retainer: Paid hourly / weekly retainer based on the scope above, with room to grow as budgets and campaigns expand.



Real Ownership: You will own Search and YouTube end-to-end for the brand — not just execute someone else's brief.



Results-Focused Relationship: We care about outcomes. If the numbers move in the right direction, this can become a long-term, expanding engagement.

title: Client Booking Coordinator - Cleaning Company
description:

We match clients with carefully vetted cleaning professionals and are expanding rapidly into new service areas. We are building our team now and looking for our next key hire.



Who We Are Looking For: A warm, people-oriented Client Booking Coordinator who genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in making sure every person who reaches out feels taken care of and gets scheduled quickly and smoothly. This role is perfect for someone who is naturally friendly on the phone, follows through without being reminded, and loves the feeling of a full, organized calendar.

During quieter periods you will work through existing inquiries that have not yet converted to bookings.

title: Media & E-Commerce Coordinator
description:
We're Five Star Napkins, the luxury organic cotton napkin trusted by Michelin-starred restaurants, five-star hotels, and Forbes Travel Guide establishments worldwide.



We're looking for a curious, self-sufficient Media & E-Commerce Coordinator to own the research and content engine behind our marketing calendar. This is not a media buying role, you won't be touching ad accounts or campaign spend. Instead, you'll be the person constantly watching what's happening in creative trends, events, hospitality, and pop culture, and turning that into ideas, content, and a well-organized
 calendar our team can act on.



This role exists to keep us plugged into what's happening in the world and consistently producing organic content, so our senior team can focus on strategy instead of chasing trends and building calendars from scratch.







What You'll Do



Primary: Trend & Cultural Research



Track current trends across creative formats, hospitality, events, and pop culture, specifically anything relevant to luxury, gifting, celebrations, and entertaining

Watch for viral moments, seasonal hooks, and cultural events (major holidays, milestone occasions, hospitality industry happenings) that we could tie creative or campaigns to

Bring these findings back to the team regularly as concrete ideas, not just a list of links





Primary: Organic Content Creation



Create organic content (short-form video, social posts) based on the trends and ideas you're researching

Turn scripts, references, and creative direction into finished content using simple editing tools (CapCut, Canva, or equivalent)

Help build toward a consistent, repeatable organic posting cadence across our social channels





Secondary: General Support (Based on Capacity)



Assist with organizing assets, briefs, and creative files so the wider team can move quickly

Support ad hoc marketing and content tasks as they come up





What You Already Know (Non-Negotiables):



You're genuinely plugged into culture, you notice trends before they're mainstream, and you can explain why something is working

You're organized and detail-oriented, a calendar you own stays accurate and current, nothing falls through the cracks

You have a good eye for content and can turn a simple brief into a finished short-form video

You're naturally curious and proactive, you bring ideas to the table rather than waiting to be told what to look for

You can take direction, run with a process, and flag when something needs a decision above your level

Required Skills

1 to 3+ years of experience in a content, social media, marketing coordination, or e-commerce support role

Working knowledge of Klaviyo or a similar
 platform (calendar/scheduling experience, campaign build experience is a bonus)

Basic video editing ability using tools like CapCut, Canva, or similar

Strong research skills, able to spot and summarize trends clearly and quickly

Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable working async with a remote team across time zones

Strong written English communication for reporting, trend summaries, and day-to-day coordination with the team

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Customer Support & Operations Specialist

Full-Time · Long-Term · Remote



Dear Applicant,



We are a rapidly growing eCommerce company currently operating across the UK, USA, Canada, and New Zealand.



What started as a single-market operation has grown into an international eCommerce business, and we are now entering an exciting phase of further expansion.



Because of this growth, we are looking for a reliable, ambitious, and flexible person to join our team and support our current VA with Customer Support, Meta Engagement, and Supply Chain Management.



This is not simply a job where you complete the same tasks every day. As the company continues to grow, there will be many opportunities to take on more responsibility, develop new skills, and potentially move into higher-level roles within the business.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not someone who is simply looking for a temporary position.



## About the Role



Your primary responsibilities will be divided across three areas:



### 1. Customer Support



You will help ensure that every customer receives a professional, friendly, and timely response.



Responsibilities include:



* Handling customer inquiries professionally and efficiently.

* Managing complaints, refund requests, and order issues.

* Responding to questions regarding tracking, shipping, products, refunds, and FAQs.

* Maintaining our target response time of 24 hours or less.

* Identifying recurring customer issues and reporting them to the team.

* Following our SOPs and ensuring responses are accurate and consistent.

* Helping improve our customer support processes and documentation.



### 2. Meta Engagement



You will also assist with managing engagement across our Meta platforms.



Responsibilities include:



* Responding to comments on
 and Instagram.

* Answering product and order-related questions in comments.

* Handling negative or sensitive comments professionally.

* Maintaining our brand voice and customer experience.

* Escalating important or unusual issues when necessary.

* Monitoring engagement and identifying recurring questions or concerns.



### 3. Supply Chain Management



As we continue expanding into multiple markets, keeping track of our supply chain will become increasingly important.



You will assist with:



* Monitoring stock levels and product availability.

* Communicating with suppliers.

* Following up on production and shipping timelines.

* Tracking purchase orders and inventory.

* Identifying potential stock shortages before they become problems.

* Communicating delays or supply issues to the relevant team members.

* Helping ensure that products remain available while maintaining efficient stock levels.

* Supporting the development and improvement of our supply chain processes.



## Daily Tasks & Reporting



You will receive daily tasks and priorities based on the current needs of the business.



At the end of each working day, you will be expected to send a daily report directly to Brian summarizing your work.



The report should include:



* Tasks completed.

* Important issues or customer cases encountered.

* Outstanding tasks that still require attention.

* Any problems or delays you noticed.

* Relevant updates regarding suppliers, stock, or shipping.

* Any suggestions or observations that could help improve our processes.



The purpose of this report is not simply to track hours. It allows us to identify problems early, improve our processes, and continuously optimize the business together.



## Required Platforms & Knowledge



Experience with the following platforms is strongly preferred:



* Gmail – Customer Support

* Shopify – eCommerce

* ChatGPT – AI assistance

* Slack and/or 
 – Team communication

* Freshdesk – Customer Support

* Meta Business Manager – Meta Engagement

* ParcelPanel – Shipping & Tracking

* DeepL – Translation



You do not necessarily need to be an expert in every platform, but you should be comfortable learning new systems quickly.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

* Experienced in Customer Support, preferably 1+ year.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Reliable and consistent.

* A strong communicator.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Able to take ownership of tasks rather than constantly waiting for instructions.

* A fast learner who enjoys learning new systems and processes.

* Flexible and willing to take on different responsibilities as the company grows.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

* Available for at least 40 hours per week once transitioned to full-time.

* Available for weekly team meetings.

* Available to start immediately.

* Not currently working another full-time job.



### Open to Feedback & Continuous Improvement



It is extremely important that you are comfortable receiving feedback.



We are a growing company, and our processes are constantly evolving. Feedback is not intended as personal criticism; it is a necessary part of improving both your performance and the business as a whole.



You should be willing to:



* Accept constructive feedback without taking it personally.

* Learn from mistakes.

* Adapt when processes change.

* Ask questions when something is unclear.

* Take suggestions seriously and implement them.

* Share your own ideas when you see opportunities for improvement.



We want team members who are not afraid to say "I think we could do this better" and who are willing to work with us to find a better solution.



Our goal is to continuously optimize the company, improve our systems, and become more efficient as we grow.



## Attention to Detail Is Extremely Important



Small mistakes can create large problems in eCommerce.



For example:



* Sending duplicate responses.

* Giving a customer incorrect information.

* Responding to the wrong conversation.

* Missing important supplier updates.

* Forgetting to follow up on an outstanding issue.

* Providing an answer that does not match our SOPs.



We therefore need someone who works carefully, checks their work, and takes responsibility for their tasks.



## What We Provide



You will receive:



* Detailed SOPs and training materials.

* Training and guidance during your onboarding.

* Direct support from our existing team.

* A clear structure and defined processes.

* The opportunity to learn multiple areas of an international eCommerce business.

* Long-term opportunities for increased responsibility.

* Opportunities for salary increases based on performance and company growth.



Because we are growing quickly, new positions and responsibilities will continue to become available.



Someone who performs exceptionally well in this role could eventually move into areas such as Operations Management, Customer Support Management, Supply Chain Management, Team Management, or other roles within the business.



## Trial Period & Compensation



The position begins with a two-week paid trial period at $4/hour.



During these two weeks, we will evaluate:



* Quality of work

* Reliability

* Communication

* Attention to detail

* Learning speed

* Initiative

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Ability to receive and implement feedback

* Overall attitude and team fit



After successfully completing the two-week trial period, the position will transition to full-time at $5/hour, with a high chance of an increase after consistently good performance.



As the company grows and your responsibilities and performance increase, there will be opportunities for additional responsibilities and future salary increases.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply wants to clock in, complete a checklist, and clock out.



We are looking for someone who sees an opportunity to become an important part of a young and ambitious company.



If you are ambitious, reliable, willing to learn, open to feedback, and excited by the idea of growing together with a company that is expanding internationally, this could be a very good long-term opportunity for you.



## Application Instructions



Please include the following in your application:



1. Previous Experience



Tell us about your previous Customer Support and/or VA experience.



2. Platforms



Tell us which of the platforms mentioned above you have experience with and how you have used them.



3. Why You?



Why do you believe you would be an excellent fit for this position?



4. Motivation



What motivates you to join a fast-growing company and grow alongside it?



5. Availability



Please tell us your current availability, including how many hours per week you can commit and when you could start.



### Important

title: Creative Strategist
description:
# Creative Strategist



Full-Time · Long-Term · Remote



Dear Applicant,



We are a rapidly growing eCommerce company currently operating across the UK, USA, Canada, and New Zealand.



What started as a single-market operation has grown into an international eCommerce business, and we are now entering an exciting phase of further expansion.



Because of this growth, we are looking for a creative, analytical, and ambitious Creative Strategist to join our team and help take our advertising and creative output to the next level.



This is not a position for someone who simply wants to make attractive ads.



We are looking for someone who understands that successful creatives are built around psychology, customer behaviour, strong messaging, testing, and continuous optimization.



You will play an important role in identifying what makes our customers stop scrolling, understand our product, trust our brand, and ultimately make a purchase.



As the company continues to grow, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility, develop your skills, and potentially move into higher-level creative or marketing roles within the business.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not someone who is simply looking for a temporary position.



## About the Role



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for developing and improving the creative strategy behind our paid advertising.



You will work closely with the existing team to understand our customers, analyse creative performance, identify opportunities, and continuously develop new concepts to test.



Your role will sit between creative thinking and data-driven decision-making.



You should be able to look at an advertisement and not only say whether it looks good, but understand why it is or is not likely to perform.



## Responsibilities



### Creative Strategy



* Develop creative strategies for our Meta advertising campaigns.

* Research customer pain points, desires, objections, motivations, and buying behaviour.

* Identify new creative angles, hooks, concepts, and messaging opportunities.

* Develop creative briefs for new advertisements.

* Translate customer insights into compelling advertising concepts.

* Study competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate our brand.

* Continuously look for new trends, formats, concepts, and approaches that could work for our audience.

* Build a structured creative testing strategy.



### Creative Testing & Optimization



* Analyse the performance of existing creatives.

* Identify winning hooks, angles, concepts, formats, and messaging.

* Identify underperforming creatives and determine what could be improved.

* Create variations of successful concepts to maximize their potential.

* Develop new iterations based on performance data.

* Continuously test new creative ideas rather than relying on the same winning advertisements.

* Keep track of creative tests and their results.

* Help establish a clear system for documenting creative learnings.



### Research



Creative strategy starts with understanding the customer.



You will regularly research:



* Customer reviews.

*
 and Instagram comments.

* Competitor advertisements.

* Competitor reviews.

* Product reviews.

* Reddit and other relevant online communities.

* Customer objections and frequently asked questions.

* Trends within the eCommerce and advertising space.

* New creative formats and advertising approaches.



The goal is to understand what customers actually think and say, rather than simply making assumptions about them.



### Meta Advertising



You will work closely with the Meta advertising side of the business.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing creative performance within Meta Ads Manager.

* Analysing key creative metrics.

* Identifying patterns between creative performance and advertising results.

* Helping determine which creatives should be scaled, iterated, or replaced.

* Communicating creative insights to the advertising team.

* Making recommendations based on data rather than personal preference.



You do not need to be a full-time media buyer, but you should understand how creative performance impacts paid advertising.



## Daily Tasks & Reporting



You will receive daily tasks and priorities based on the current needs of the business.



At the end of each working day, you will be expected to send a daily report directly to Brian summarizing your work.



The report should include:



* Tasks completed.

* Creative concepts or angles developed.

* Research completed.

* Important findings or customer insights.

* Creative tests or iterations worked on.

* Performance insights where applicable.

* Outstanding tasks.

* Any problems or challenges encountered.

* Suggestions or ideas for improving our creative strategy.



The purpose of this report is not simply to track hours.



It allows us to stay aligned, identify problems early, understand what is being worked on, and continuously optimize the creative process and the business as a whole.



## Required Knowledge & Experience



Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



* Meta Ads Manager

*
 and Instagram

* eCommerce advertising

* Creative strategy

* Direct-response marketing

* Customer research

* Competitor research

* Ad copywriting

* Creative testing

* Performance analysis

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Canva and/or other creative tools



Experience with video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools is a plus.



You do not necessarily need to be an expert in every platform, but you should be comfortable learning new tools and systems quickly.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly creative but also analytical.

* Naturally curious and constantly looking for new ideas.

* Able to think from the customer's perspective.

* Strong in written English.

* Comfortable researching and analysing information.

* Able to explain why a creative idea should work.

* Data-driven and willing to let results determine decisions.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Reliable and consistent.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Able to take ownership of projects.

* A fast learner who enjoys learning new systems and processes.

* Flexible and willing to take on additional responsibilities as the company grows.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

* Available for at least 40 hours per week once transitioned to full-time.

* Available for weekly team meetings.

* Available to start immediately.

* Not currently working another full-time job.



## Open to Feedback & Continuous Improvement



It is extremely important that you are comfortable receiving feedback.



We are a growing company, and our creative strategy will constantly evolve as we gather more data and learn more about our customers.



Feedback is not intended as personal criticism. It is a necessary part of improving both your work and the business as a whole.



You should be willing to:



* Accept constructive feedback without taking it personally.

* Learn from mistakes.

* Change your approach when the data shows something is not working.

* Adapt when processes or strategies change.

* Ask questions when something is unclear.

* Take suggestions seriously and implement them.

* Share your own ideas when you see opportunities for improvement.

* Challenge existing ideas respectfully when you believe there is a better approach.



We want someone who is not afraid to say "I think we could do this better" and is willing to test that idea.



Our goal is to continuously optimize our creative strategy, improve our advertising, and become more effective as we grow.



## Attention to Detail Is Extremely Important



Creative strategy involves many moving parts, and small mistakes can have a significant impact.



For example:



* Using the wrong product information.

* Missing an important customer insight.

* Failing to properly document a creative test.

* Misinterpreting performance data.

* Repeating an idea that has already been tested without a clear reason.

* Creating concepts without understanding the target customer.

* Failing to follow through on a promising creative opportunity.



We therefore need someone who works carefully, thinks critically, checks their work, and takes responsibility for their projects.



## What We Provide



You will receive:



* Training and onboarding.

* Access to our existing SOPs and processes.

* Direct communication with the team.

* Access to relevant creative and advertising data.

* The opportunity to work with an international eCommerce company.

* The opportunity to learn multiple areas of performance marketing and eCommerce.

* Long-term opportunities for increased responsibility.

* Opportunities for salary increases based on performance and company growth.



Because we are growing quickly, new positions and responsibilities will continue to become available.



Someone who performs exceptionally well in this role could eventually grow into positions such as Senior Creative Strategist, Creative Lead, Head of Creative, Performance Marketing Manager, or other roles within the business.



## Trial Period & Compensation



The position begins with a two-week paid trial period at $4/hour.



During these two weeks, we will evaluate:



* Quality of work.

* Creativity.

* Strategic thinking.

* Communication.

* Attention to detail.

* Learning speed.

* Initiative.

* Ability to follow processes.

* Ability to receive and implement feedback.

* Ability to analyse information and draw useful conclusions.

* Overall attitude and team fit.



After successfully completing the two-week trial period, the position will transition to full-time at $5/hour, with a high chance of an increase after consistently good performance.



As the company grows and your responsibilities and performance increase, there will be opportunities for additional responsibilities and future salary increases.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply wants to create advertisements based on personal taste.



We are looking for someone who wants to understand why people buy, what makes them stop scrolling, what makes them trust a brand, and how we can turn those insights into better-performing creative.



We want someone who combines creativity with curiosity, strategy, and data.



If you are ambitious, creative, analytical, reliable, open to feedback, willing to learn, and excited by the idea of growing together with a young company that is expanding internationally, this could be a very good long-term opportunity for you.



## Application Instructions



Please include the following in your application:



1. Previous Experience



Tell us about your previous experience with Creative Strategy, Meta advertising, eCommerce, or related fields.



2. Creative Experience



Tell us about a successful advertisement or creative concept you have worked on. What made you believe it would work, and what was the result?



3. Research & Strategy



Explain how you would research a new product before developing advertising creatives for it.



4. Why You?



Why do you believe you would be an excellent fit for this position?



5. Motivation



What motivates you to join a fast-growing company and grow alongside it?



6. Availability



Please tell us your current availability, including how many hours per week you can commit and when you could start.



### Important



To make sure applicants carefully read the entire job description, please include the word "Elephant" somewhere in your motivation letter.



Every application will be reviewed carefully, including with AI-assisted screening tools designed to assess effort, authenticity, attention to detail, and overall quality.



Generic, low-effort applications or applications that appear to have been generated entirely by AI without genuine personal input will not be considered.



We are looking for serious, ambitious professionals who want a long-term opportunity and are willing to invest the effort required to grow with the business.



We look forward to hearing from you.



Thank you,

Brian.

We are looking for a proactive SEO, GEO, Content & AI Marketing Manager to join our team full time and long term.



The role has a strong focus on SEO, Local SEO, AEO/GEO and visibility in AI-driven search, while also covering content, digital marketing, analytics and practical AI automation.



We are looking for someone who understands how businesses can improve their visibility not only in Google, but increasingly across platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI-powered search environments.



You should be able to analyse opportunities, turn them into practical actions and take ownership rather than simply waiting for tasks.



Key Responsibilities



• Develop and implement SEO, Local SEO and AEO/GEO strategies for different clients.

• Conduct keyword, competitor, search intent and content gap research.

• Improve website structure, internal linking, metadata, content and on-page SEO.

• Identify opportunities to improve visibility in Google and AI-powered search engines.

• Research topics, entities, questions and content opportunities relevant to AI search and traditional search.

• Monitor performance using Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools.

• Turn SEO and performance data into clear recommendations and actions.

• Create and optimise website copy, articles, landing pages, headlines and marketing content.

• Support content strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and other channels where relevant.

• Coordinate marketing projects, developers, content production and client deliverables.

• Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for research, analysis, content and productivity.

• Build or support practical automations using tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier.

• Continuously research new developments in SEO, GEO, AI search and digital marketing.

• Support lead generation through prospect research, lead scraping, data enrichment and structured outreach workflows.



What We Are Looking For



• 2+ years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, content or a related field.

• Strong understanding of SEO and on-page optimisation.

• Good understanding of AEO, GEO, AI Search or LLM visibility, or a strong willingness to specialise in this area.

• Experience with Google Search Console and GA4.

• Strong keyword, competitor and content research skills.

• Strong written English.

• Ability to create and optimise high-quality marketing and website content.

• Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

• Good organisation and project management skills.

• Proactive, analytical and comfortable working independently.



Experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, Google Business Profile, YouTube SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, structured data/schema markup, AI agents or web scraping is an advantage.



• Experience with lead scraping, web scraping, prospecting tools, data enrichment or CRM workflows is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



How We Work



We value people who:



• understand the business objective behind the tasks

• take ownership and identify opportunities independently;

• combine analytical thinking with strong content judgement;

• turn data and research into practical actions;

• actively follow developments in Google Search and AI Search;

• use AI intelligently rather than simply generating content;

• look for ways to improve and automate processes.



A question we want you to ask regularly is:



“Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?”



Commitment & Compensation



This is a full-time, long-term position: 8 hours per day.



Our team works primarily during European business hours, so reliable overlap with CET/CEST is required.



Starting compensation: USD 500 per month, full time, with the possibility to grow based on performance, responsibility and long-term fit.



Start the first sentence of your application with the word “SEO” so we know you have read the full job description.



How to Apply



Please include:



• A short introduction and your relevant experience.

• Your location, time zone and availability.

• Your SEO experience and examples of websites or projects you have worked on.

• Examples of keyword research, content optimisation, Local SEO, technical/on-page SEO or SEO strategies you have implemented.

• Any experience with AEO, GEO, AI Search or optimising content for platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity.

• Examples of content, landing pages, articles or campaigns you have created or improved.

• SEO, analytics, AI and automation tools you regularly use.

• An example of an AI workflow or automation you have created, if available.



Please confirm whether the stated compensation of USD 600 per month is within your expectations.



We are particularly interested in understanding how you analyse a website, identify opportunities, prioritise actions and improve organic and AI-search visibility — not simply which tools you have used.

Hiring. You write the job posts, you screen, you run the trials, you make the call. We hire editors, designers, copywriters and support staff constantly. That whole function becomes yours.

You'll tell us when we're wrong.

Full time. Long term. Reports directly to the founder.

Most of it is already documented and you'll be trained on the rest.

title: Python / Supabase Developer – Data Collection & API Automation
description:
We are looking for a reliable developer to build a small pilot data-automation project for our software company.



The initial project involves collecting newly filed business-registration records from Harris County, Texas, storing and organizing that information in Supabase, and then sending the records to a third-party skip-trace/data-enrichment service.



If the pilot works well, there will be substantial additional work expanding the system to other counties and data sources.



Current Data



The county provides records similar to:



File Number

DBA Name

Address

City

State

ZIP



Example:



B703034

FF ROOFING

5103 HARBOR PALM

RICHMOND

TX

77469



What We Need Built



The developer will:



* Automatically collect/import new Harris County DBA/Assumed Name records

* Store the original records in Supabase/PostgreSQL

* Normalize and clean the data

* Prevent duplicate records from being processed multiple times

* Send addresses to a third-party reverse-address skip-trace/enrichment provider

* Receive and store the enrichment response

* Extract useful contact information such as mobile phone numbers and
s

* Maintain a clean, usable lead record separate from the raw data

* Prepare the resulting records for later CRM/API integration

* Add basic processing/error logging



The skip-trace service may return a very large number of fields. We do not want hundreds of fields imported into our CRM.



We primarily care about extracting useful information such as:



* Contact/person name when available

* Primary mobile phone

* Secondary mobile phone when useful

*
 address

* Phone type

* Verification/confidence information

* Last-seen/recency information

* Match status



The complete raw enrichment response can be retained separately.



Important



This is a pilot project, not a statewide system.



We want to prove Harris County first.



The architecture should, however, be designed so that if the pilot works, we can later add additional counties without rebuilding the entire system.



Conceptually:



County Data

     ↓

Collector / Importer

     ↓

Supabase

     ↓

Normalization + Deduplication

     ↓

Skip Trace / Enrichment API

     ↓

Clean Contact Record

     ↓

CRM / Outreach



Skills We Are Looking For



Strong experience with some or all of the following:



* Python

* Supabase

* PostgreSQL

* REST APIs

* API integrations

* Web scraping / data collection

* ETL / data processing

* Data normalization

* Deduplication

* Scheduled jobs / cron

* JSON

* Webhooks



Experience with lead-enrichment or skip-trace APIs is a plus.



Initial Deliverable



For the first project, we want to successfully process approximately 100–500 Harris County business records through the complete pipeline.



We should be able to see:



* Records collected

* Unique records

* Records sent for enrichment

* Successful enrichment results

* Mobile numbers found

*
s found

* Failed records/errors



If the pilot is successful, the next phase will include additional Texas counties, CRM integrations and further automation.



When Applying



Please answer these questions in your application:



1. How many years have you worked with Python or Node.js?

2. Have you worked with Supabase/PostgreSQL? Please describe.

3. Have you built web scrapers, ETL pipelines or automated data collectors?

4. Have you integrated third-party APIs before?

5. Have you worked with skip-tracing, lead enrichment, people-search or similar data APIs?

6. How would you prevent duplicate records from being processed?

7. How would you structure this so additional counties can be added later?

8. Approximately how long would you expect the Harris County pilot to take?



Please include links or brief descriptions of similar projects you have completed.



Important Application Instruction



Start your application with the words:



HARRIS COUNTY



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be reviewed.



Employment Type



Project-based initially, with strong potential for ongoing work.



We are building a larger software and automation platform, so a successful developer could have significant additional work after this pilot.



⸻



Please text me at WhatsApp I during central standard business hours

title: Experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter – Business Funding | Base + Commission
description:
PillarStar Capital is a growing U.S. business-funding company looking for an experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter to join our team.



This is not an entry-level cold-calling position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), alternative business funding, and how to speak confidently with U.S. business owners.



Your primary goal is to turn leads into qualified merchants with completed applications and bank statements.



You will work leads provided by PillarStar and move merchants through:



Lead → Conversation → Interest → Qualification → Application/Bank Statements → Complete Package



Our processing and closing team will handle the later stages of the transaction.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners.

Speak with owners and decision makers.

Identify current or future business-funding needs.

Determine requested funding amount and use of funds.

Ask about monthly business revenue.

Identify existing MCA positions and payments.

Qualify merchants according to PillarStar guidelines.

Request applications and recent business bank statements.

Handle common merchant objections professionally.

Follow up aggressively but professionally with interested merchants.

Re-engage previous leads.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up dates.

Work closely with processing and closing staff.

Help consistently generate complete funding packages, not just calls.

Who We Are Looking For



2+ years of direct MCA/business-funding experience is strongly preferred.



You should already understand terms such as:



First position

Second position

Stacking

Daily/weekly payments

Bank statements

Revenue qualification

Funding applications



You should also have:



Strong spoken English.

Clear, confident phone presence.

Experience calling U.S. business owners.

Strong objection-handling skills.

Experience asking merchants for applications and bank statements.

CRM and outbound-dialer experience.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Backup internet/power.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation



Starting rate: $4.00/hour



Strong candidates with verifiable MCA experience may start higher, up to $5.00/hour.



There will be a 30-day performance review, with opportunities for increases based on results.



You will also earn:



5% of PillarStar Capital's commission actually collected on funded transactions originating from your assigned leads.



Commission is earned only after the transaction funds and PillarStar receives its commission.



As the company grows, strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, bonuses, senior sales responsibilities, and advancement into closing roles.



How Performance Is Measured



We care about results, not meaningless dialing.



We measure:



Calls → Merchant Conversations → Interested Merchants → Applications/Statements Requested → Complete Packages → Funded Deals



We also measure call quality, attendance, follow-up, CRM accuracy, professionalism, and package quality.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PILLARSTAR MCA – [Your Name] – [Years of MCA Experience]



Please submit:



1. Your resume



2. A REQUIRED 60–90 second voice sample



In your normal speaking voice:



Introduce yourself.

Tell us how many years of MCA/business-funding experience you have.

Give us a 20–30 second example of how you would open a call with a U.S. business owner.

Then answer this merchant objection:



“I'm not sending you my bank statements until you tell me what rate you're offering.”



Do not submit an AI-generated voice.



Answer These 7 Questions

How many years have you worked specifically in MCA or alternative business funding? What were your roles?

In your most recent MCA role, approximately how many complete applications + bank-statement packages did you personally generate per week?

Approximately how many funded transactions per month originated from your opportunities, if your company tracked this?

Explain the difference between a first-position MCA, second-position MCA, and stacking.

Write exactly what you would say if a merchant tells you:

“I'm not sending statements until you tell me the rate.”

Which MCA CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms have you previously used?

What hourly rate are you currently seeking, and are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours?



Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and live MCA merchant role-play.

This position will help ensure that required documentation, employee files, client records, credentialing information, training requirements, and internal compliance processes are completed accurately and on time.

* Maintain organized electronic compliance files

* Assist management with policy and procedure tracking

* Review records for consistency with company requirements

* Report significant compliance concerns to management

* Assist with corrective action follow-up

* Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For

* Medical records

* Credentialing

* Quality assurance

* Deficiencies identified

* Items corrected

* Upcoming expiration dates

Compensation

Schedule

How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe any experience you have with healthcare, compliance, credentialing, medical records, or quality assurance.

3. Have you previously worked for a U.S.-based healthcare company?

4. What systems or software have you used?

5. Describe how you would manage 50 employees with certifications and licenses that expire on different dates.

6. If you discovered that an employee's required credential expired two weeks ago, what steps would you take?

7. Describe how you stay organized when managing multiple deadlines.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during U.S. Eastern Time.

Important



This position requires someone who is comfortable holding others accountable for completing required documentation.
