title: Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
About us

We are a Sydney-based digital marketing agency. We run SEO, Google Ads, content and AI-search visibility programs for Australian e-commerce and B2B businesses, including two of the country's larger online commercial kitchen equipment retailers, a stone-slab manufacturer and a gaming-peripherals store.

We are a small team that works closely with automation. A lot of our on-page, content and reporting work is systemised, and it is producing rankings. Our off-page authority is now the ceiling. We have tried bulk link vendors and mass outreach and neither earned links that matter. We want a person who knows how real links get earned in a market like Australia and can build that capability properly.

The role

You will own link acquisition across our client portfolio and our own agency site. That means finding the sites that are realistically going to link to a commercial kitchen equipment retailer or a stone manufacturer, working out what those sites need from us, making the approach, following it through, and proving the link is live and worth having.

You will not be sending templated
s to a scraped list. We have automation for volume already. Your value is the judgement in front of it: qualifying prospects, choosing the angle, building relationships with editors and trade bodies, vetting any paid placement so we never buy spam again, and turning client assets into things people want to cite.

About 50% of the time is prospecting and qualification, 30% is outreach and relationship follow-up, and 20% is linkable-asset planning, vetting and reporting.

What you will do

Prospecting and qualification

Build and maintain a prospect bank per client: trade publications, industry associations, supplier and manufacturer partner pages, Australian business directories that carry weight, local media, complementary businesses, and resource pages that already link to competitors.

Qualify every prospect on whether it actually links out to businesses like ours, not just whether the topic matches. Check outbound link patterns, editorial standards and freshness before anyone spends time on it.

Reverse-engineer competitor backlink profiles and separate the links we can realistically replicate from the ones we cannot.

Score and document prospects in our shared tracker so the outreach pipeline has clean targets to work with.

Outreach and relationships

Write personalised approaches to editors, association staff, suppliers and business owners. Each one cites something specific about their site and offers something they want: data, an expert quote, a product for review, a partner listing, a fix for a broken link.

Run follow-up sequences and keep a live record of every conversation, status and next action.

Work with our automated outreach pipeline: you set the targets and angles, review and approve drafts, and feed back what wins and what fails so the pipeline gets smarter.

Handle supplier and partner links directly: many of our clients' brands have "where to buy" or dealer pages we are not on yet.

Linkable assets and digital PR

Identify what each client could publish that would earn citations: buying guides, Australian benchmark data, compliance explainers, calculators, original photography. Brief our content team on what to make and why it will get linked.

Pitch client expertise to Australian media and journalist-request services (SourceBottle, Qwoted and similar) for expert quotes and mentions.

Coordinate press-style placements around client news, product launches and case studies.

Vetting, quality control and reporting

Vet any proposed paid placement or guest post site before purchase: real traffic, real editorial, no PBN or web 2.0 footprint, relevant to the client, not selling links to everyone. Recommend or reject with reasons. Andy approves spend.

Verify each acquired link is live, indexed, dofollow where agreed, and pointing at the correct URL. Re-check at 30 and 90 days and chase removals.

Maintain a monthly report per client: new referring domains, quality tier of each, target pages linked, what was pitched and the response rate, what is in progress.

Flag anything that looks like a toxic-link risk and recommend whether a disavow is warranted.

What we need from you

Must-haves

2+ years of hands-on link building or digital PR outreach where you personally earned links from real editorial sites. You can show examples and explain how each one happened.

You understand the difference between a link that moves rankings and a link that is just a number. You can spot a PBN, a web 2.0 network or a link farm in a few minutes and explain what gives it away.

Excellent written English. Your outreach
s are short, specific and human, and you can adjust tone from a trade editor to a small-business owner.

Comfortable with SEO tooling: backlink analysis (SE Ranking, Ahrefs, Semrush or Majestic),
 finding and verification, Google Search Console, and spreadsheets as your working tracker.

Organised and persistent. Outreach is a pipeline of many small follow-ups over weeks, and you keep every thread alive without being told.

Honest reporting. You tell us when a month was weak and why. We would rather hear "zero links, here is what I learned" than see inflated numbers.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in the Australian, UK or US market, or with B2B and trade industries rather than lifestyle niches.

Digital PR experience: journalist requests, data-led stories, expert commentary placements.

Experience with e-commerce clients, where the link targets are category and product pages rather than blog posts.

Familiarity with outreach automation platforms such as Smartlead, Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Respona.

Basic content brief writing, so you can tell a writer exactly what a linkable asset needs to contain.

Not a fit if

Your experience is mainly buying guest posts from marketplaces or running "DA 50+ guaranteed" packages.

You measure success in link count rather than referring-domain quality and target-page impact.

Working arrangements

Full-time, 40 hours per week, flexible schedule with at least 5 hours overlapping 9am–5pm Sydney time. Australian public holidays are observed.

Remote from home. You supply your own computer and internet; we provide all software and tool seats.

Paid twice monthly via Wise or a payroll platform. 13th-month pay included. Paid leave after a 3-month probation period.

You will work directly with the founder and with our automated systems. There is a lot of room to shape how this function runs.

Regular pay reviews tied to results and responsibility.

How to apply

Reply with the following. Applications that skip any item will not be considered.

Your CV and your OnlineJobs.ph profile link (or LinkedIn), including English test results if you have them.

Three links you personally earned for a previous employer or client. For each one: the linking page URL, the target page, how the placement happened, and roughly how long it took. Paid placements are fine to include if you say so.

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.

Written answers to these three questions:

Q1. Our client sells commercial ovens and commercial fridges to Australian restaurants and cafes online. List 8 realistic types of website or organisation that might link to their category pages, and for each one say in a sentence what we would offer them so they say yes.

Q2. A vendor offers 200 backlinks for AUD 150, or a "DA 55 guest post" for AUD 60. Write the 5 checks you would run before recommending either, and what result on each check would make you say no.

Q3. Paste one real outreach
 you have sent that won a link. Names and domains can be blurred. Then tell us in two sentences why you think it worked.

Start your application with the word ANCHOR so we know you read the full post.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

[2] The Role



As an Executive Partner in paid media, you will own the performance of the ad channels we give you. You buy the media, watch the numbers every day, and tell the team what they mean and what to do next.



Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. That means your report has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.



For your first month or two you will bring your recommendations to the marketing lead for approval. Once you have shown you can read the numbers, you optimise on your own.



---



[3] What You'll Do



What you own:



- How your channels perform. Keep the channels assigned to you running, and grow them. That means managing the spend, creating and managing the ad accounts, setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, and flagging billing before a lapse stops our campaigns.

- The daily report. Build and maintain it across every funnel, and know why each formula works rather than just where to type the number. Leadership never opens the ad platforms, they read your report. It has to be right every day.

- How the agency content performs. Several agencies produce and post content for us. You get it live as ads on time, and you own how it does once it is running.

- Keeping the accounts alive. Our product category is high risk for ad and account bans. Monitor policy changes, spot the risk early, and act before a channel gets disrupted.

- Spotting things first. Flag underperformance, anomalies or opportunities before anyone asks.



What you work out:



- Analyze the data. Not just what happened, but why, and what to do next.

- Analyze creatives against performance and say what we should make more of.

- Research what is working for other brands and competitors. Not just ads: landing pages, messaging, offers and campaign strategies. Bring back specific things we should test, and draft the advertorials yourself (AI tools welcome).

- Look beyond your own assignment. Check what is happening on the other channels so you understand the whole picture.



What you run day to day:



- Launch ads at volume across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola and Google. Several hundred a week, mostly through bulk tools rather than one at a time.

- Work with our internal creative team and our external agencies on what is coming and when.

- Work directly with platform reps on rejections, approvals and questions.



---



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days



- Your channels are growing. Spend and revenue up, ROAS held at target.

- You have a repeatable way to test creatives, and you are consistently finding and scaling the winners.

- Nothing has stopped. No campaign down because of a billing lapse, a rejected account, or a policy change you did not see coming.

- Your reports are trusted. Leadership d
 off them without going to check the platforms.

- You are bringing ideas, not just numbers. Things you found working for other brands that we should be testing.



---



[5] What We're Looking For



- You understand how paid ads work on at least one platform. Not just uploading. You know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero.

- Initiative. You see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week who has this and who does not.

- You ask questions constantly. We would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes in it.

- You treat the work as yours. The people who do well here push on something because they spotted the opportunity, not because someone asked them to.

- Strong attention to detail — accuracy in the data, polish in the presentation.

- Able to present data clearly — formatting, structure and visual clarity matter.

- Open to working on any platform — Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola, Google. You may be strongest on one, but you will not get to stay there.

- Comfortable with bulk launch tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, or able to pick it up fast.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and numbers.

- Familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.

- Has used AI tools in their workflow (preferred, not required).

- Agency or in-house media buying experience is a plus. Time served matters less than knowing what you are looking at.



One thing this role is not: you will not be designing creatives. Our internal team and our agencies produce the assets. You shape what they make by telling them what the data says is working, and you will write advertorials yourself.



If you have read this far: open your video by naming which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched. Be honest. Nobody has all six, and we would rather know now.



---



[6] Schedule



5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We will confirm which days when we assign your channels.



If we ask you to cover a sixth day, that is overtime.



---



[7] What You'll Get



- Attractive starting rate and grow fast — starting at USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month

- Two weeks of one-on-one walkthrough training with the marketing lead

- Paid subscriptions to the tools you need

- Direct access to global founders and operators

- Mentorship and clear growth paths

- Real spend across six platforms on a brand that is scaling. That is a track record you can point at later.

- Fully remote setup

- Asia Time Zone

- Work that truly matters — every report you build drives real revenue decisions for global brands



---



[8] HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here:







You will be asked to:



1. Upload your CV or LinkedIn profile

2. Record a short Loom video (2-3 mins) covering:

- Which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched

- Your relevant paid media or marketing experience

- Why you are interested in this role



In the video, also answer this:



Last 7 days, three ads:



- Ad A: $120 spent, 1 purchase, $95 revenue

- Ad B: $2,400 spent, 41 purchases, $4,300 revenue

- Ad C: $310 spent, 6 purchases, $680 revenue



Which one would you scale, and why? A minute is plenty. We are listening for how you think, not how polished you are. It is the main thing we shortlist on.



Applications sent outside this link will not be reviewed.

title: Remote Bookkeeper (UK Accounting Firm)
description:
We are SBX Accountants, a fast-growing UK-based accountancy practice working with small businesses, mostly Limited Companies and Sole Traders. We are expanding our delivery team and are looking for an experienced remote bookkeeper to support our client work.



This is a long-term role for the right person.



The role

This position is for a highly-skilled bookkeeper, with occasional administrative and ad-hoc support tasks as required. You will work closely with a UK Chartered Accountant and be part of a growing, process-driven firm.

You must be qualified in bookkeeping and have experience working with UK clients.



Responsibilities

• Day-to-day bookkeeping for UK limited companies and sole traders

• Bank reconciliations and ledger maintenance

• Reviewing transactions

• Correct VAT treatment of transactions at bookkeeping level

• Identifying and flagging potential VAT or coding issues for review

• Assistance in preparing for the year-end accounts, including posting journals/accounting adjustments where needed

• Excel-based tasks and data organisation

• General administrative and ad-hoc support tasks related to bookkeeping and internal firm processes



Key requirements (essential)

• Proven experience in UK bookkeeping

• Qualified bookkeeper (or equivalent professional qualification)

• Several years’ hands-on bookkeeping experience

• Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks and Xero (both required)

• Fluent spoken and written English

• Experience working remotely

• High attention to detail and accuracy

• Proactive, reliable, and able to manage work independently

• Comfortable following processes and implementing feedback



All work is reviewed and supervised - you are not client-facing.



Skills & attributes

• Excellent organisational skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to follow instructions and learn from feedback

• Understanding of confidentiality and data protection requirements

• Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting systems

• Reliable internet connection and home working setup

• Desire to work with a growing UK accountancy practice and take on a greater level of workload and responsibility over the coming months.



Working hours

• 20 hours per week expected, with likely full time capacity over the coming months

• Hours can be flexible

• Opportunity to increase hours significantly as SBX continues to scale

• Pay will be reviewed as responsibility increases, with progression available for high-quality, reliable work.



How to apply

Please include the following in the first 3 lines of your application:

1. Your bookkeeping qualification

2. Your most relevant UK bookkeeping experience (company, dates)

3. Your availability (hours per week and preferred working times)

4. Your experience with QuickBooks and Xero

5. Your favourite hobby!



Final note

This role is best suited to an experienced bookkeeper, and someone who is willing to get stuck in on admin-tasks when bookkeeping work is light. We are looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding UK practice.

title: GoHighLevel Implementation & Client Success Operator
description:
GoHighLevel Implementation & Client Success Operator — Long-Term Growth Role



We are a growing U.S. company that helps residential electricians get found, get trusted, and get hired.



I am looking for one exceptional Philippines-based GoHighLevel operator who can take ownership of new-client technical implementation and grow into client onboarding, operations, and eventually customer success.



This is a real, immediate opening with long-term growth potential.



This role will begin with a paid technical test and client implementation work while our client base grows. My intention is for the right person to grow into a significant part-time and ultimately full-time role and make this their primary professional commitment.



This is NOT a generic VA position.



I want someone who knows GoHighLevel extremely well and can independently configure, troubleshoot, QA, document, and improve sophisticated client systems.



Ideally, you know the technical side of GoHighLevel better than I do.



I want someone I can rely on as the technical authority — not someone waiting for me to explain how every part of GoHighLevel should work.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term part of the business, not someone looking to complete random tasks or collect another freelance client.



WHAT WE ALREADY HAVE



Our core GoHighLevel system is already built as a snapshot.



It includes:



Client website

Lead capture and routing

Pipelines and forms

SMS/email workflows

Missed-call / instant text-back

Reputation/review-request automation

Conversation AI chatbot

AI voice assistant that answers incoming calls

Other follow-up and client communication automations



You will not be starting from a blank account or designing our entire system from scratch.



Your job is to take our established system, customize it correctly for each new client, test everything thoroughly, identify weaknesses or opportunities for improvement, and help make the system better as we grow.



IMMEDIATE RESPONSIBILITIES



For each new client, your core responsibility will be to own the technical implementation from start to finish, including:



Create and configure the GHL subaccount

Deploy the correct snapshot

Customize the existing website with client branding, services, service areas, phone numbers and business information

Connect and configure domains and DNS when needed

Configure LeadConnector phone/SMS and call forwarding

Prepare and submit U.S. A2P 10DLC registrations

Troubleshoot A2P rejections

Configure and test missed-call / instant text-back

Configure and test review-request automations

Verify forms, calendars, pipelines, notifications and workflows

Verify lead routing and client notifications

Assist with Google Business Profile configuration when needed

Configure and test our Conversation AI chatbot

Configure and test our AI voice/call assistant

Test websites on desktop and mobile

Perform complete end-to-end QA

Fix anything that is not working correctly

Document the completed setup



A client implementation is not complete simply because the snapshot was installed.



I expect you to personally verify that calls, texts, forms, workflows, review requests, AI conversations, lead routing, notifications and the website actually work before handoff.



I want someone who thinks beyond:



“I completed the task.”



and instead asks:



“Does the entire system actually work for the client?”



OUR ONBOARDING PROCESS IS STILL BEING BUILT



Our technical system already exists, but our complete new-client onboarding process is not yet fully documented as an SOP.



Initially, I will personally participate in onboarding and customer success.



One of your early responsibilities will be helping me turn our real-world onboarding process into a clean, repeatable system.



I want someone who can identify exactly what information and access we need from every client, find missing steps and unnecessary friction, create implementation and QA checklists, document exceptions and troubleshooting procedures, and continuously improve the process.



I am looking for someone who brings expertise and judgment to the table.



If you know a better way to configure, automate, test or deploy something, I want you to tell me.



I want the person I hire to eventually know this system so well that I can rely on their technical judgment rather than being the person who has to figure everything out first.



AI & AUTOMATION EXPERIENCE IS IMPORTANT



Our system includes both a GoHighLevel Conversation AI chatbot and an AI voice assistant that answers incoming calls.



Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel Conversation AI and/or Voice AI is strongly preferred.



Relevant experience includes:



AI prompts and instructions

Knowledge bases

Lead qualification

Capturing caller/customer information

Appointment or callback handling

Routing and human handoff

Workflows triggered by AI interactions

Testing AI calls and conversations

Troubleshooting incorrect or unexpected AI responses

Improving prompts and call flows

Monitoring AI performance

Preventing hallucinations or inappropriate responses

Escalating situations appropriately to a human



I want someone who understands that an AI system needs to be configured intelligently, stress-tested, monitored and continually improved.



Experience with additional AI/automation tools such as Vapi, Retell, n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs or webhooks is also valuable.



WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW



Initially, I will personally manage client relationships.



However, I want the right person to quickly begin participating in and eventually owning client onboarding.



Over time, I want this person to:



Conduct new-client onboarding calls

Collect everything required to launch a client

Own implementation from onboarding through launch

Maintain and improve SOPs and QA systems

Monitor client accounts for technical problems

Proactively identify issues before clients notice them

Communicate directly with clients

Make routine client-requested changes

Help clients understand and use their system

Monitor and improve AI calls/conversations

Help clients get maximum value from what we provide

Eventually own ongoing client success and retention



The long-term opportunity is to become the person who owns much of what happens after a new client signs up.



I am looking for someone who wants to own a business function, not simply complete assigned tickets.



As our client base grows, I want this role to grow with it and ultimately become the person's primary full-time position.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please apply only if you already have strong, real-world, hands-on GoHighLevel experience.



I am not looking for someone who recently completed a course and is looking for their first serious GHL opportunity.



Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with many of the following:



GHL subaccounts and snapshots

A2P 10DLC / LeadConnector

Websites and funnels

Workflows and automations

Reputation management / review requests

Missed-call text-back

LC Phone / SMS

Forms and calendars

Pipelines

Domains / DNS

Google Business Profile

Conversation AI

Voice AI

Troubleshooting and QA



Experience with U.S. home-service businesses such as electricians, plumbers, HVAC or roofing is a plus.



Experience with client onboarding, customer success, operations management, RevOps, project management, SOP creation or process improvement is a major plus.



EXCEPTIONAL ENGLISH IS REQUIRED



This role is intended to become highly client-facing.



You must have exceptional spoken and written English and be able to communicate naturally, confidently and professionally with U.S. small-business owners.



You should be comfortable:



Leading Zoom onboarding calls

Speaking naturally without relying on scripts

Building rapport

Asking intelligent follow-up questions

Understanding conversational American English

Explaining technical issues in simple language

Handling confused or frustrated clients calmly

Writing clear, professional
s and messages

Representing our company professionally without me being on the call



Exceptional English communication is mandatory.



Technical ability alone is not enough for this position.



THE PERSON I WANT



I value:



Ownership

Excellent judgment

Deep technical competence

Attention to detail

Reliability

Problem-solving

Proactive thinking

Strong documentation

Exceptional communication

Ability to work independently

Curiosity and continuous improvement

Genuine care about client outcomes



If you discover a problem, I don't want you to simply tell me there is a problem.



I want your instinct to be:



Investigate it → understand it → fix it if possible → test the fix → document what happened → tell me what you did.



And if you see something that could be done better, I expect you to speak up.



IMPORTANT: INDIVIDUAL ROLE / NO SUBCONTRACTING



I am hiring one individual, not an agency.



You must personally perform the work assigned to you.



Do not give our passwords, client information, account access or work to friends, coworkers, agencies or subcontractors without my explicit written permission.



If you encounter something you do not know how to do, be transparent about it.



Asking a question is fine.



Giving an unapproved person access to our systems or client accounts is not.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



The first technical implementation will be a paid $50 USD test project using our standardized system.



For ongoing standardized client implementations, the current target is $50 per completed client setup.



The initial workload will be lighter while our client base grows.



As responsibilities expand into onboarding calls, AI management, SOP/process ownership, operations and client success, responsibility and compensation will increase accordingly.



The right person can grow into a significant recurring role and ultimately a full-time position as our client base expands.



Quality, ownership, communication and long-term fit matter more to me than finding the lowest-cost applicant.



We are hiring now and will move quickly once we find the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send me a generic cover letter.



Start your application with:



“I personally perform my GHL work.”



Then answer:



How long have you personally worked inside GoHighLevel, and what types of businesses/accounts have you worked on?

Tell me about the most recent U.S. A2P 10DLC registration you personally completed. Have you handled a rejection? What caused it and how did you resolve it?

Have you personally deployed snapshots into client subaccounts? What do you check after deployment before considering an account ready?

Have you configured review-request workflows and missed-call text-back? What do you test before launch?

Have you built or customized websites/funnels inside GHL?

Have you personally worked with GHL Conversation AI or Voice AI? Explain what you built, what the AI was responsible for, and how you tested it.

Have you conducted onboarding calls or communicated directly with U.S. clients? Describe that experience.

Tell me about one SOP, QA system or business process you personally created or significantly improved.

Tell me about a technical or operational problem you discovered before the client noticed it. What did you do?

Are you currently working for another employer or clients? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?

Do you currently own, operate or work for an agency? If yes, please explain.

If this role grows into full-time work, are you willing to make Automatic For You your primary professional commitment?

What type of role would you ideally like to have two years from now?

VIDEO REQUIRED



Please also send a 3–5 minute Loom video with your camera on.



In the video:



Introduce yourself

Explain one GoHighLevel system you personally built or managed

Explain one difficult technical problem you personally solved

Briefly describe any Conversation AI or Voice AI work you've done

Tell me why this particular long-term role interests you



Do not read from a script.



Speak naturally as if you were explaining something to one of our electrician clients.



I will evaluate both your technical experience and your spoken English/client communication ability.



Do not reveal another client's confidential information in your application or video.



If you are excellent at GoHighLevel, strong with automation and AI, communicate exceptionally well, think like an operator, and want to become a trusted long-term part of a growing company, I especially want to hear from you.

real engagement—this is the perfect role for you.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Repurpose long-form video content into short-form posts, including video clips, graphics, memes, and captions

NICE TO HAVE

If you’re ready to be a part of a dedicated team and are eager to pursue a path of continuous learning and career

title: Recruiter for Offshore Talent | Sourcing + Screening | Ongoing, Paid Per Hire
description:

We want one recruiter we can message and say "we need a designer" and have a shortlist of three strong people within a week.

WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Write and post job ads on OnlineJobs.ph and other channels, using our voice and format

* Search the resume database proactively rather than waiting on applicants

* Screen applicants: English quality, portfolio review, red flags, salary fit

* Run first-round interviews on Zoom and score against a scorecard we build together

* Deliver a shortlist of 3 with your notes and a clear recommendation

* Coordinate the paid test task and reference checks

* Keep a warm bench of past strong candidates so future searches start faster



YOU MUST HAVE



* Recruitment or HR experience hiring remote Filipino staff, ideally through OnlineJobs.ph

* Excellent spoken and written English, you will be the first impression of our brand

* Genuine screening judgement, we do not want 40 forwarded resumes

* Availability for interview calls in Philippine business hours

* Discretion, you will see our pay rates and internal structure



NICE TO HAVE



* You have hired creative or technical roles before, not just general VAs

title: E-commerce Operations & Customer Support Specialist
description:
About us

We are an Australian online retailer of commercial kitchen equipment, We carry around 49 brands and more than 2,000 products on Shopify — cooking equipment, refrigeration, warewashing, benching and fit-out gear — and sell to restaurants, cafes, hotels, caterers and kitchen fit-out contractors across Australia.

We run from a Sydney head office and showroom, with partner warehouses in Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth. Our promise to customers is simple: the widest range at a guaranteed lowest price, backed by real local support.

We are a small, fast-moving team. You will work directly with the business owner, not through layers of management.

The role

You will be the operational backbone of the store: the person who makes sure every order moves from checkout to delivery cleanly, that every customer gets a fast, clear answer, and that the Shopify catalogue stays accurate.

This is not a call-centre or scripted-chat role. Commercial customers ask real questions about specifications, freight, lead times and warranty, and they expect competent written answers. You will learn our products, our suppliers and our freight process, and become the person the owner trusts to run the day-to-day.

About 60% of the work is logistics and order operations, 30% is customer and sales support, and 10% is Shopify catalogue and admin.

What you will do

Order and logistics operations

Process daily Shopify orders: confirm stock with our warehouses and suppliers, raise purchase orders, and book freight.

Coordinate deliveries of large, heavy commercial equipment: tailgate and forklift requirements, delivery windows, site access, and regional consignments.

Track every open shipment and proactively update customers before they have to ask.

Handle delivery exceptions: delays, damaged freight, missed deliveries, re-deliveries and returns. Own each case through to resolution.

Keep supplier lead times and stock positions up to date so the sales team quotes accurately.

Maintain a clean order pipeline: no order sits without a status, a next action and an owner.

Customer and sales support

Answer customer
s and web enquiries within agreed response times, in clear, professional Australian business English.

Respond to pre-sale questions on products, specifications, compatibility, lead times and freight costs, using supplier spec sheets and our product pages as your source of truth.

Prepare quotes for multi-item and trade orders and follow up on open quotes.

Coordinate warranty and after-sales claims between the customer and the manufacturer's service network.

Escalate pricing decisions, disputes and anything you are not sure about to the owner, with a clear summary and a recommended action.

Shopify catalogue and admin

Update product data: pricing, stock status, lead-time notes, specifications and images, working from supplier information.

Spot and fix catalogue errors (wrong specs, missing images, broken variants) as you find them.

Keep the shared inbox, order notes and internal trackers tidy so anyone can pick up where you left off.

Produce a short daily end-of-day report: orders processed, shipments booked, open issues and what needs the owner's decision.

What we need from you

Must-haves

2+ years in e-commerce operations, order fulfilment, logistics coordination or customer support for an online store.

Hands-on Shopify admin experience: orders, fulfilment, products, variants and inventory. Not just theory.

Excellent written English. You will write to Australian business customers every day and your
s must be clear, warm and correct the first time.

Confident, direct communicator who asks questions early rather than guessing.

Fast learner who is comfortable with technical products. You do not need to know commercial kitchens today, but you must be able to read a spec sheet and explain it plainly.

Highly organised. You track many open items at once and nothing gets dropped.

Able to work Sydney business hours from a quiet home office with a reliable computer, stable internet (25 Mbps+) and a backup connection or power plan.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with Australian freight: booking through carriers or freight forwarders, understanding tailgate delivery, pallets and regional surcharges.

Experience selling or supporting B2B, trade or high-ticket products (equipment, machinery, furniture, appliances).

Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and shared inbox workflows.

Basic Xero or invoicing experience.

Experience communicating with Chinese or overseas suppliers on stock and lead times.

Working arrangements

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday on Sydney time. Australian public holidays are observed.

Remote from home in the Philippines. You supply your own computer and internet; we cover work software.

Paid twice monthly via Wise or a payroll platform. 13th-month pay included. Paid leave after a 3-month probation period.

Long-term role. We are hiring someone to grow with the business, not to fill a short project.

Regular pay reviews tied to performance and responsibility.

How to apply

Reply with the following. Applications that skip any item will not be considered.

Your CV and your OnlineJobs.ph profile link, including your English and DISC test results.

A screenshot of the Shopify orders screen from a store you have actually managed, with the store name blurred out.

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.

Written answers to these three questions:

Q1. A customer's freight is now five days late and the carrier has no update. Write the
 you would send to the customer.

Q2. A customer asks whether a 900mm-wide gas cooktop will work in their kitchen. What questions do you ask before you answer, and where do you find the answer?

Q3. Describe a time you handled many open orders or tickets at once. How did you keep track and what did you do when something went wrong?



Start your application with the word BENCHTOP so we know you read the full post.

* Correct and resubmit rejected or denied claims when appropriate

* Maintain an organized list of outstanding claims

* Post or reconcile insurance payments as assigned

* Verify that services documented have been billed

* Identify missing documentation that may prevent billing

* Identify authorization or eligibility problems affecting claims

* Communicate billing issues to management and clinical/administrative staff

* Maintain accurate notes regarding claim follow-up activity

* Assist with accounts receivable and aging reports

* Escalate claims that require additional intervention

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Healthcare billing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand or have experience with:



* U.S. healthcare insurance billing

* Behavioral health or mental health billing

* Medicaid claims

* CMS-1500/professional claims

* Claims submission

* Denials and rejections

* EOBs and ERAs

* Accounts receivable

* Insurance eligibility

* Prior authorizations

* Claim status follow-up

* Payment reconciliation





Skills Needed



The right person must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching billing problems

* Able to follow a claim from submission through payment

* Comfortable communicating professionally by
 and telephone

* Able to document their work clearly

* Able to recognize when something does not look correct

* Reliable and consistent with attendance

* Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours



Strong written English and professional communication skills are required.



Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the billing process.



You should not simply report that a claim was denied.



We expect you to determine:



Why was it denied?

Can it be corrected?

What information is missing?

Who needs to take action?

What is the next step?



Our goal is to maintain clean claims, reduce denials, follow up aggressively on outstanding balances, and make sure the company receives payment for services that have been properly provided.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour with Bonus



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate. Performance, reliability, accuracy, and demonstrated ability to manage claims independently will be considered during future compensation reviews.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe your previous U.S. healthcare billing experience.

3. What types of insurance or Medicaid claims have you worked with?

4. Have you worked with behavioral health or mental health billing?

5. What billing or EHR systems have you used?

6. Describe how you would handle a claim that was submitted but has not been paid after 30 days.

7. Describe a denial you have handled in the past and how you resolved it.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during **U.S. Eastern Time**.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn our organization, take ownership of our claims, and become a dependable long-term member of our administrative team.

title: # Social Media Manager & Google Ads Specialist — Multiple Brands
description:
## About the Role



We are looking for a creative, organized, and results-driven **Social Media Manager and Google Ads Specialist** to manage the online presence and paid advertising campaigns of multiple brands.



This is not a role where you simply schedule posts. We need someone who can understand each brand, create an appropriate content strategy, coordinate the production of engaging content, manage advertising campaigns, and use performance data to improve results.



You will work with brands in different industries, so you must be comfortable switching between different audiences, brand voices, products, and business objectives.



## Key Responsibilities



### Social Media Management



- Manage the social media accounts of multiple brands.

- Develop a separate content strategy and brand voice for each business.

- Create monthly and weekly content calendars.

- Plan content for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Write clear, engaging captions and calls to action.

- Create or coordinate graphics, carousels, short-form videos, Stories, and Reels.

- Schedule and publish content consistently.

- Repurpose existing videos, images, blogs, and other materials into social media content.

- Research trends, competitors, hashtags, and content opportunities.

- Monitor comments, messages, reviews, and audience engagement.

- Maintain organized folders for content, brand assets, approvals, and published posts.

- Ensure that each brand’s content is accurate, consistent, and visually professional.

- Provide regular reports covering growth, engagement, reach, leads, and conversions.



### Google Ads Management



- Create and manage Google Search, Display, Performance Max, remarketing, and YouTube campaigns when appropriate.

- Conduct keyword, audience, competitor, and market research.

- Write effective ad headlines, descriptions, and extensions.

- Organize campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, and negative-keyword lists.

- Monitor budgets, bids, search terms, conversions, and campaign performance.

- Improve click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per lead, and return on advertising spend.

- Identify and pause wasteful keywords, placements, audiences, and advertisements.

- Recommend landing-page improvements based on campaign performance.

- Set up or verify conversion tracking using Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and relevant website or customer relationship management systems.

- Prepare clear weekly and monthly reports explaining results, problems, and recommended next steps.

- Maintain accurate records showing what was changed, why it was changed, and how it affected performance.



### Multi-Brand Account Management



- Keep each brand’s accounts, files, calendars, budgets, and reports properly separated.

- Learn the products, services, customers, competitors, and goals of each brand.

- Follow different brand guidelines and approval processes.

- Prioritize tasks based on deadlines and business impact.

- Communicate proactively when assets, approvals, access, or information are missing.

- Attend regular online meetings and provide concise progress updates.

- Work collaboratively with business owners, designers, video editors, developers, and other team members.



## Required Qualifications



- At least two years of professional experience managing business social media accounts.

- Demonstrable experience managing Google Ads campaigns using real advertising budgets.

- Strong written English and attention to grammar.

- Experience creating content calendars and platform-specific content.

- Ability to write in clearly different voices for multiple brands.

- Working knowledge of Canva or Adobe design tools.

- Experience with Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools.

- Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, and conversion tracking.

- Understanding of key metrics such as cost per click, cost per lead, click-through rate, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend.

- Strong organizational and task-management skills.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate consistently.

- Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and an appropriate home-working environment.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing both business-to-business and business-to-consumer brands.

- Experience with Meta Ads is a strong advantage.

- Experience editing short-form videos using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or a similar tool.

- Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, landing pages, and lead-generation forms.

- Experience with local-service advertising and ecommerce campaigns.

- Familiarity with Google Looker Studio.

- Experience with project-management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or 
.

- Basic search-engine-optimization knowledge.

- Experience using artificial intelligence tools responsibly for research, ideation, and first drafts without publishing generic or inaccurate content.



## What Success Looks Like



The right person will:



- Publish consistent, high-quality content without requiring constant reminders.

- Preserve the distinct identity and voice of every brand.

- Increase qualified engagement, traffic, inquiries, and leads.

- Manage advertising budgets responsibly.

- Use performance data to make practical decisions.

- Catch tracking or campaign problems before they become expensive.

- Communicate problems early and propose solutions.

- Maintain clear documentation so that account activity can be reviewed.

- Continuously test new ideas while protecting brand quality.



## Important Expectations



- You must review and understand content before publishing it.

- Unedited artificial-intelligence-generated content is not acceptable.

- You must verify claims, dates, prices, links, spelling, and contact information.

- Advertising reports must explain business results, not merely list impressions and clicks.

- Major campaign changes must be documented.

- Advertising budgets may not be substantially increased without approval.

- Client information, account credentials, and business data must remain confidential.

- You must be able to manage several brands without mixing their content, assets, audiences, or advertising accounts.



## Schedule and Employment Details



- **Position:** [Full-time or part-time]

- **Working hours:** [Insert preferred working hours and time zone]

- **Weekly hours:** [Insert number of hours]

- **Salary:** [Insert monthly salary or salary range]

- **Payment schedule:** [Weekly, twice monthly, or monthly]

- **Start date:** As soon as possible

- **Long-term opportunity:** Yes

- **Time tracking:** [Required or not required]



Some overlap with our normal working hours may be required for meetings, approvals, and campaign coordination.



## Tools You May Use



- Google Ads

- Google Analytics 4

- Google Tag Manager

- Meta Business Suite

-
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube

- Canva

- CapCut or similar video-editing software

- Google Drive and Google Sheets

- A social media scheduling platform

- A project-management system

- Google Looker Studio



Experience with every tool is not required, but you must be comfortable learning new systems.



## How to Apply



Please include all of the following in your application:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

2. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile.

3. Links to at least three social media accounts you have managed.

4. Two or three examples of content you personally planned, wrote, designed, or edited.

5. A description of the Google Ads campaigns you have managed.

6. An anonymized screenshot or report showing actual Google Ads performance.

7. The approximate monthly advertising budgets you have managed.

8. The platforms and tools you use regularly.

9. Your availability, preferred working hours, and expected monthly salary.

10. Your internet speed and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



At the beginning of your application, write the words **“MULTI-BRAND GROWTH”** so we know you read the entire job description.



## Application Questions



Please answer the following questions:



1. How would you organize content, approvals, advertising, and reporting for five different brands?

2. What information would you request before creating a social media strategy for a new brand?

3. What steps would you take if a Google Ads campaign were generating clicks but no leads?

4. Which Google Ads campaign types have you personally managed?

5. How do you verify that conversion tracking is working correctly?

6. Which social media metrics do you consider most important, and why?

7. Describe one campaign that did not perform well. What did you change?

8. How do you use artificial intelligence tools without producing generic or inaccurate content?

9. What is the largest monthly Google Ads budget you have managed?

10. Are you willing to complete a short paid assessment?



## Hiring Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



1. Attend a brief video interview.

2. Review a sample brand and explain their proposed strategy.

3. Complete a short paid assessment involving:

   - A one-week social media content plan.

   - Two sample social media posts.

   - A brief Google Ads account or campaign review.

   - A short explanation of recommended priorities.



The paid assessment is for evaluation purposes. Applicants will not be asked to perform substantial unpaid client work.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and takes ownership of both creative quality and measurable business results.

title: Video Editor Longterm
description:
This is a long-term position with opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on quality, reliability, turnaround time, and channel growth.

Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates who fit our current budget.



### Expected Workload

We are looking for an editor who can consistently edit approximately 10-15 long-form videos per month.

The exact workload may vary depending on channel needs.



### About Us

We operate multiple faceless YouTube channels focused on:

* History

* Economics

* Geopolitics

* Business History

* Documentary Storytelling



We are looking for a skilled editor who understands viewer retention and can transform a script and voice-over into an engaging documentary-style video.



### Important

**This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for editors who can create engaging documentary-style videos by combining storytelling, research, footage sourcing, graphics, music, and pacing.**



### What We Provide

For each video, we will provide:

* Complete script

* Voice-over recording

* Reference YouTube video(s)

* Creative direction and feedback



### Your Responsibilities

* Edit high-retention YouTube videos (20–30 minutes)

* Source relevant stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, and B-roll

* Add text, motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements

* Select appropriate background music and sound effects

* Follow the editing style of our reference videos

* Deliver projects on schedule

* Revise videos based on feedback when necessary



### Requirements

* Strong experience editing YouTube videos

* Excellent storytelling and pacing skills

* Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

* Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

* Ability to independently source visuals and assets

* Reliable communication and attention to detail

* Good English comprehension

### Preferred Experience: Comfortable creating/editing longform videos



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To confirm you have read this entire job posting:

1. Include the word **HAPPY** as the second line of your application so we know that you read the requirements and expectations.

2. Answer all application questions below.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.



### Application Questions

1. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited, long form preferred.

2. Which editing software do you use?

3. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?

4. Have you edited documentary, history, business, or storytelling channels before?

5. If I provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage, images, maps, and graphics yourself? Please explain your process.

6. How many 20–30 minute documentary videos can you realistically edit per month?

7. How many hours per week are available?

8. Do you have reliable internet and if so what is your internet speed?

10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



### Final Selection Process

To be considered for this position, shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a 60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over recording, and reference video that we provide.

The purpose of this test is to evaluate:

* Storytelling ability

* Editing style

* Visual sourcing skills

* Pacing and viewer retention

* Sound design

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions



Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit.

Due to the volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the test materials.



### Long-Term Opportunity

We are building multiple YouTube channels and are looking for a reliable editor to grow with us long-term.

Strong performers will receive:

* Higher monthly compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Additional editing projects

* Opportunities to work across multiple channels



If you are passionate about creating engaging documentary-style YouTube content, we would love to hear from you.

title: Deal Manager - US Real Estate Dispositions & Closings (Remote, US Eastern hours)
description:
We are a Norfolk, Virginia (USA) real estate investment company operating across five LLCs - flipping houses, wholesaling deals, and managing a rental portfolio in Virginia and North Carolina. 200+ transactions since 2015. We are a HomeVestors franchise.



We already have lead generation handled. We already have someone who signs contracts. What we do not have is anyone who owns what happens AFTER the contract is signed - moving the deal to a buyer, to the closing table, and to money in the bank. That is this seat, and dispositions is the heart of it.



Here is the honest picture of what you would be walking into, measured in our CRM this month:



- 87 leads. ZERO are assigned to one single owner - every one is assigned to two or three people, so each assumes someone else has it.

- Under-contract date, under-contract price, scheduled closing date: 0 of 87 filled in. The fields exist. They are all empty.

- 31 leads are parked waiting on an offer or an appointment, 26 of them 18+ days old, because nothing flags a deal that stops moving.

- A deal closed on the 14th of this month. We found out on the 18th, and only because a settlement statement happened to land in an inbox. Nothing in the pipeline showed it existed. That same statement had a commission computed on one sales price while the contract price on the same page was materially lower - and nobody caught it before signing.



If reading that made you want to open a spreadsheet, keep reading.



THE SEAT IN ONE LINE: you manage the work, not the people.



You are the third seat on a three-person acquisitions team, and you sit BESIDE the other two, not above them. One teammate owns raw lead to scored to hot handoff. One owns hot lead to appointment to signed contract. You own everything after the signature: the buyer, the paperwork, the deadlines, the closing table, and the money - plus you keep the whole pipeline honest by flagging anything that stops moving.



You will not set anyone's targets and you will not run anyone's review. You own the facts; the Operations Manager owns the enforcement. Your pressure comes from a visible, dated flag list read out at standup every morning, and anything that has not moved in 48 hours goes up to Operations with its history attached.



=====================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

=====================================================



1) DISPOSITIONS - the core of the seat



- Find and lock the end buyer on every wholesale and assignment deal we put under contract. Cash buyers, landlords, other investors, agents with investor clients.

- Build and maintain our buyers list. We do not have a real one yet. You will.

- Price the assignment to actually move, and negotiate the assignment fee.

- Get the deposit collected and the assignment paperwork out.

- When a deal is not selling, say so early and come with the reason - price, condition, area, or buyer pool - not five days before closing.



2) OWN - contract to cash



- Build and own the deal board. Every deal that goes under contract gets a row on day one and keeps it until funds are confirmed: address, deal type, contract date, contract price, deposit and whether it was actually received, inspection deadline, financing deadline, title company and file number, title ordered / commitment received, end buyer and their deposit, scheduled closing date, extensions used, expected proceeds or assignment fee, status, and next action + who + by when.

- Work the critical dates. Inspection, financing, title commitment, deposit, extensions - deadlines inside 5 days get handled first.

- Call the closing side live. Title companies, lenders, closing attorneys. An unanswered
 is not a follow-up.

- Hold the seller's hand. Sellers under contract go quiet and get cold feet. Weekly minimum, more as closing approaches.

- Read the settlement statement before it is signed and reconcile it against the contract. See the story above.



3) WATCH AND FLAG - the pipeline as a system



Every morning, sweep our CRM and the franchise system and build one list: every lead and every deal that needs an action today. The triggers are written down and not up to your mood: new lead with no contact attempt in 24 hrs, contacted but unscored in 48 hrs, scored hot but not handed off same day, parked at offer-needed 7 days, appointment run with no offer in 48 hrs, offer made with no seller response in 5 days, under contract with no board row same day, any critical date inside 5 days immediately.



Every flag carries three things: the lead, the NAME of the person who owns the next action, and the DATE it is due. A flag without an owner and a date is a complaint, not a flag.



End of every day: a short report - what moved, what did not, what is blocking.



=====================================================

WHAT THIS SEAT DOES NOT DO - read this twice

=====================================================



- Does not quote or negotiate the purchase price with sellers. Buy-side pricing sits with the acquisitions seat, and above a threshold, the owner. Your negotiating is on the SELL side - the assignment fee and the end buyer.

- Does not sign, send, or modify contracts.

- Does not d
 to kill a deal. You recommend; acquisitions or the owner d
.

- Does not move money or touch banking credentials. Ever.

- Does not set targets or run performance reviews for anyone.

- Is not a cold-calling or appointment-setting seat. We have that covered.



=====================================================

WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR - please self-select out

=====================================================



- Not an appointment setter or a lead-gen caller. That seat is filled. You will not be handed a dial list and a script.

- Not a general VA. This is not inbox management, calendar work, or data entry with a real-estate label on it.

- Not a manager-of-people role. No direct reports, now or later. If the appeal is the word "Manager" in the title, we are not a match.

- Not a seat for someone who needs a finished playbook. The deal board does not exist yet - building it is day two.



=====================================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================================



REQUIRED - this is what we are actually screening on:



- 2+ years in US real estate DISPOSITIONS. You have personally sold or assigned deals to end buyers. Wholesale assignments, novations, JV dispo, or flip dispo all count.

- You have built or worked a real cash-buyers list and can describe how you built it, how you kept it warm, and how big it got.

- You have carried deals from signed contract through closing - title company, lender, attorney, deadlines, settlement statement.

- You know what a settlement statement is and you have caught an error on one.

- Comfortable on the phone with US buyers, sellers, and closing professionals. Clear spoken English.

- Organized to the point of being slightly annoying about it. Deadlines are the entire job.

- Willing to tell a teammate, in front of the team and without apology, that something on their plate has been sitting for eleven days.

- Reliable computer, reliable internet, quiet space for calls.



A PLUS, BUT NOT REQUIRED:



- Lead management / ISA / acquisitions experience. Useful context, and it will help you read the front half of the pipeline - but it is not what this seat is measured on, and it will not make up for thin dispositions experience.

- Real estate CRM experience (REsimpli, Podio, Salesforce, or similar).

- Title-portal experience (Qualia, ResWare, SoftPro).

- HomeVestors or franchise-system familiarity.



=====================================================

WHAT WE WILL GIVE YOU

=====================================================



- A $250 bonus on every deal you close, uncapped, on top of the hourly rate.

- A written operating manual for this seat. The triggers, the escalation ladder, and the board fields are already documented, not improvised.

- A daily 15-minute standup where your flag list is the agenda.

- A working escalation path: what you flag and nobody moves on goes to the Operations Manager with your history attached, and he acts on it.

- Direct access to decision-makers. No committee.

- Existing systems you operate rather than build - CRM, automated lead-gen, automated valuation, and a real vendor stack of title companies, lenders, property managers, and a CPA.

- A pipeline with deals already in it and nobody working the back half. Your bonus is not theoretical.



=====================================================

PAY, HOURS AND TERMS

=====================================================



PAY: $5.00 per hour, 30 hours per week.

PLUS a $250 bonus for every single deal that closes. There is no cap on it - it is paid on every closing you carry to the table.



US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM ET (30 hours per week). The 8:00 AM start is fixed - team standup is 8:00 to 8:15 ET.

Independent contractor, 30-day mutual evaluation period. Time tracked in Hubstaff.



=====================================================

HOW TO APPLY - answer these in your application

=====================================================



Applications without answers to these will not be reviewed.



1. Can you work US Eastern hours Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM Eastern, starting at 8:00 AM every day for our team standup? (yes/no)



2. Are you willing to track your working hours in Hubstaff, screenshots and activity levels, for this role? (yes/no)



3. How many years have you personally worked US real estate DISPOSITIONS, meaning selling or assigning deals to end buyers? Answer with one of: none / lead gen only, 0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+.



4. What was your number in your last role? Give us the actual metric you were measured on and the actual figure you carried - deals assigned or sold per month, average assignment fee, days-on-market for your dispo, transactions managed at once, whatever it was. If you were never measured on a number, say so plainly. That is an acceptable answer, but say it.



5. Walk us through your buyers list. How did you build it from zero? How many buyers were on it, and how many of those actually bought more than once? What did you do to keep it warm? Be specific - where the names came from and how you sorted them.



6. You have a wholesale deal under contract. Closing is in 9 days. You have no end buyer, and the two who walked the property both went quiet. What do you do, day by day, for the next 9 days? Tell us what you would change, who you would call, and at what point you would tell the owner it is not going to sell.



7. Here is our real situation. We have zero deals with an under-contract date recorded and no deal board at all. Nobody is your subordinate - the two people who own the front of the pipeline sit beside you as peers. What do you do in your first week? Day by day.



8. You are reviewing a settlement statement the day before closing. The commission line is calculated on a sales price that is higher than the contract price printed on the same page. What do you do, in what order, and who do you call?



Honest and specific beats polished. A short paragraph each is plenty.
