title: E-commerce & Social Media Virtual Assistant
description:
What this job is

Miçanga Swim is a small, growing swimwear brand in Los Angeles. Our founder designs everything, shoots all our content, runs our pop-ups, and manages production in Brazil. She has more good ideas than time to execute them.

That's where you come in. This is an execution role. You'll take a clear list of tasks and get them done consistently, week after week, without needing to be chased. If you're someone who likes checking things off and keeping a system running smoothly, you'll do well here.

You don't need to invent the plan. You need to run it.



What you'll actually do

Shopify store (about half your time)

Our store needs real work and we know exactly what it needs:

    •    Write and optimize product listings with SEO (titles, descriptions, tags, alt text)

    •    Build out size charts across every product

    •    Standardize product images so the store looks consistent

    •    Install and configure apps: size chart app, FAQ page, store locator,
 popup, shoppable Instagram feed, appointment booking

    •    Build out an FAQ page and a landing page

    •    Keep collections organized and seasonal

    •    Make sure every product is listed, complete, and live

    •    Process orders and update tracking

    •    Flag anything broken or off-brand

Social media (about a third of your time)

Our founder shoots great content. She goes viral regularly. The problem is consistency, and that's what you'll fix.

    •    Post 3 Instagram feed posts per week from content she provides

    •    Post 4 Instagram stories per week

    •    Post 3 TikToks per week

    •    Write captions in our brand voice

    •    Respond to DMs and comments on both platforms

    •    Light editing and cutting of clips she sends you

    •    Build simple graphics in Canva when we need them (sale announcements, size guides, story templates)

    •    Keep a running content calendar so we always know what's going out

    •    Join a short planning call every Sunday

Customer service and organization (the rest)

    •    Answer customer
s: sizing, shipping, returns, product questions

    •    Keep an organized file system for photos, videos, and product assets

    •    Name and sort content so we can actually find things later

    •    Keep a shared task list current and flag what needs the founder's decision

    •    Short weekly check-in on what got done and what's next



What we need from you

Required:

    •    Real hands-on Shopify experience. You've managed a store, not just seen one.

    •    Comfortable installing and configuring Shopify apps

    •    Solid written English. You'll be writing captions and talking to customers as our brand.

    •    Canva skills at a working level

    •    Experience scheduling and posting to Instagram and TikTok

    •    Organized. You keep files named and systems tidy without being told.

    •    Reliable. You do what you said you'd do, and you say something when you can't.

    •    Steady internet and clear communication

Helpful but not required:

    •    Fashion, swimwear, or lifestyle brand experience

    •    Basic photo or video editing (Lightroom, CapCut, or similar)

    •    Klaviyo or
 marketing experience

    •    Product photography editing and retouching

    •    Experience with a small brand where you wore a lot of hats



A normal week

    •    Optimize 5-8 product listings with SEO and size charts

    •    Install or configure an app we've asked for

    •    Post 3 IG feed posts, 4 stories, 3 TikToks

    •    Write the captions for all of it

    •    Answer 20-30 customer
s and DMs

    •    Make 2-3 Canva graphics

    •    Organize the week's new photos and video into the right folders

    •    Sunday planning call and a short Friday update on what shipped



First 30 days

    •    Every product listing has SEO, a complete description, and a size chart

    •    The core apps are installed and working

    •    Social is posting on schedule without the founder having to think about it

    •    Customer
s answered within 24 hours

    •    A file system exists and is being used

First 90 days

    •    Store is fully built out: FAQ, landing page, store locator, popup, IG feed

    •    Social has been consistent for three months straight

    •    You own customer service end to end

    •    The founder no longer thinks about posting, listings, or inbox



About Miçanga Swim

Miçanga Swim is an independent swimwear and activewear brand born between Los Angeles and Rio de Janeiro. We're inspired by the confidence, color, and effortless sexiness of Brazilian beach culture, combined with influences from founder Alena Slapak's Brazilian and Indian experiences.

Every piece is designed in small batches and produced in Brazil. Authentic Brazilian cuts with playful details, beading, and embroidery.

Community is the heart of what we do. We pop up almost every weekend at flea markets, vintage stores, and local events around Silver Lake and Echo Park, and we've built a loyal following across Los Angeles and San Diego through pop-ups, pool parties, wellness events, and customization experiences. We recently opened our first showroom in Downtown LA.

Most of our sales have come from meeting people in person. Our next chapter is bringing that same energy online, and that's the job you'd be helping with.

At its core Miçanga is about great bikinis, self-expression, and building a community people actually want to be part of.



Why this role exists

Our founder does design, production, photography, pop-ups, and travels to Brazil to manage manufacturing. The online side keeps getting pushed to whenever she has a spare hour, which means it moves slowly.

We want someone to own it so it stops depending on her. If you do this well, you'll see the store grow and you'll have had a direct hand in it.



How to apply

Send us:

    1    A short note about why this role interests you

    2    Links to two or three Shopify stores you've worked on, and what you did on them

    3    An example of social media you've managed

    4    Your rate, your weekly availability, and your time zone

    5    One thing you'd change about our site after looking at 

That last one matters most. We want to see how you think.

title: Experienced Amazon Recovery Manager (Reimbursements)
description:
--- Applications without practical Seller Central and Vendor Central recovery experience will not be considered ---



Build our Amazon recovery service from the ground up



You know where money gets lost inside Amazon.



You know how to find it, prove it and recover it. You understand Seller Central reimbursements and Vendor Central disputes from practical experience.



Now you want to build the complete operation behind it.



That is the role.



----



What you will build



Brightways is a marketplace agency from Rotterdam. We help established brands grow on Amazon and bol.

We want to offer Amazon recovery as a service to our clients. The process, knowledge and technology will remain within Brightways.



We are not looking for someone who simply operates an external reimbursement platform. We need someone who understands the data, calculations, evidence and claim logic behind every recovery.



You will design how the service works. This includes account audits, claim validation, case management, payment reconciliation, reporting and quality control.



You will then run the process across Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts.



----



Seller Central



You know how to investigate missed reimbursements, FBA inventory discrepancies, inbound shipments, customer returns, removal orders and incorrect fees.



You can work directly with Amazon reports and account data. You know what evidence Amazon requires and when a claim is valid.



----



Vendor Central



You can investigate shortages, deductions, chargebacks and payment differences.



You understand purchase orders, invoices, delivery documentation and dispute management. You can follow a discrepancy from the original transaction to the final payment.



----



Building the service



Your role goes further than recovering individual claims.



You will document the method, define controls and create clear reporting. You will also help integrate recovery into our existing client operations.



Where software can improve speed or accuracy, we want to build it ourselves. You will help translate your recovery knowledge into clear rules and software requirements.



You do not need to be a software developer. Experience with data automation, APIs, SQL or scripting is a strong advantage.



----



Who we are looking for



You have proven experience with both Seller Central and Vendor Central recovery.

This experience is required. General Amazon experience or experience with only one of the two platforms is not enough.



You can perform an audit without depending on an external recovery provider. You understand why a claim exists, how its value is calculated and which evidence supports it.



You work carefully. You do not submit weak or duplicate claims. Protecting the client account matters as much as recovering revenue.



You also enjoy building something new. When no process exists, you know how to create one.



----



What success looks like



Brightways has a reliable recovery service that can support multiple client accounts.

Every opportunity is validated. Every case is documented. Every payment is checked.

Clients can see what was found, what was claimed and what was recovered. Our team can follow the process without losing control or quality.



----



Interested?



Start your VIDEO application with “Recovery with control”.



Tell us:



1. How much experience you have with Seller Central and Vendor Central recovery.

2. Which recovery categories and Vendor disputes you have personally handled.

3. About one complex recovery case and the result you achieved.

4. How you would audit an account without an external reimbursement platform.

5. Whether you have built a recovery process, workflow or internal tool before.



Hours: to be discussed

title: Content & Design Assistant (WordPress + Canva) for Australian Fashion Media Brand
description:
We're The Bridal Journey, an Australian bridal media brand. We publish editorial about weddings, fashion and design for an audience of 375,000 across Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and our podcast. Think Vogue and Net-a-Porter rather than a wedding planning blog.



We're small, and everything we publish has to look considered. We're looking for one person to own the production side of that, working directly with our founder.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Building and publishing 2 blog posts a week in WordPress using our Bricks templates. We write the copy, you build the page, source and place the imagery, and get it live.

- Building our weekly Shop My edit posts, where products, imagery and affiliate links are pulled together into a designed post.

- Sourcing imagery from Pinterest and our own library, and crediting photographers properly.

- Building and organising our image library so we stop starting from scratch every week.

- On-page SEO: page titles, meta descriptions, alt text, slugs, categories, internal links.

- Scheduling Pinterest pins. Pinterest is one of our biggest channels at 2.5 million monthly views.

- Scheduling social content across Instagram and TikTok.

- Fashion week support. We cover bridal fashion weeks in New York, Barcelona, Paris and London. You'll compile runway galleries, match designer and collection names, chase and record photographer credits, and get galleries live to deadline. Our next one is New York in six weeks.

- Campaign wrap reports. After a brand partnership runs, pulling reach, engagement and click figures from Instagram, Pinterest and analytics into our reporting template.

- Keeping our vendor directory current and onboarding new vendor listings.

- Adding and maintaining marketplace listings.

- Light design work in Canva, applying our existing brand templates to social graphics, banners and gallery covers.

- Keeping a simple tracker of what's outstanding with our designer and web developer, and chasing them for status so nothing sits in a hole.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Solid WordPress experience. Bricks Builder is a bonus, but you can learn it in an afternoon if you know page builders.

- Confident in Canva, working to an existing brand system rather than inventing your own.

- A genuine eye. This is the important one. Our whole product is taste, so we need someone who notices when spacing is off, when an image is the wrong crop, when a page just doesn't look right. If that isn't you, this role will frustrate us both.

- Careful, organised and reliable to a weekly deadline. A lot of this is deadline work.

- Good written English. You'll be reading briefs, chasing suppliers and flagging problems, not writing our copy.

- Comfortable telling us when something looks wrong or doesn't make sense. We would much rather hear it than not.

- An interest in fashion, design or photography is a real plus. It's most of what you'll be looking at.



HOURS AND TIMEZONE



40 hours a week, Monday to Friday. We're in Australia, so your day overlaps almost entirely with ours, which is part of why we're hiring in the Philippines.



WHAT IT'S LIKE WORKING WITH US



You'll work directly with our founder, alongside a designer and a web developer. We're not an agency and there's no layer of account managers. Your work goes live under a brand people actually read. We pay weekly for your first two months, then move to the 15th and 30th like everyone else. All payments via Wise, and we pay 13th month.



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the word MANTILLA so we know you've read this properly.



Then send us:



A link to a WordPress site or blog post you've built. Not a CV, an actual link to something you made. If you can only show one thing, show us the page you're proudest of.

One sentence on something you'd change about our homepage at 
. Be honest, we'd rather hear it.

Your earliest start date.

title: Junior Video Editor to Viral Content Creator (Remote)
description:
Junior Video Editor



ABOUT THE ROLE



Work directly with Unsighted — a viral content creator, rapper, and public figure creating uplifting, high-energy projects designed to entertain, inspire, and connect people around the world.



We are looking for a creative, fast, reliable, and highly intuitive Video Editor to join Unsighted's growing team.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great editing is knowing when to cut, when to hold a moment, what makes people laugh, what keeps people watching, and how to make a story through a video. 

Unsighted's content is spontaneous, energetic, emotional, and filmed in public with real people. We're looking for someone who can take raw footage and turn it into engaging short-form content that feels natural, authentic, and highly watchable. Also looking for someone who is well versed in meme sounds and gen z humor.



If you're someone who spends way too much time on TikTok analyzing why certain videos go viral, understands internet culture, has a strong sense of pacing, and gets genuinely excited about making a great edit, we'd love to hear from you!



This can grow into a stable, long-term position with increasing responsibility as the brand continues to grow.



This role will be primarily utilizing Capcut.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Editing short-form videos for all social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat, etc). 

- Turning raw footage into engaging and concise videos

- Identifying the strongest moments, reactions, jokes, and interactions

- Creating strong hooks within the first few seconds

- Cutting videos with strong pacing and retention in mind

- Adding captions, subtitles, sound effects, music, and other elements when appropriate

- Editing content in a way that feels authentic to Unsighted's personality and brand

- Creating multiple versions or cuts when needed

- Repurposing longer footage into multiple short-form pieces

- Editing content from events, tours, interviews, and collaborations

- Following basic brand guidelines while still keeping the content creative and organic

- Taking feedback and making revisions quickly

- Organizing project files and edited content

- Staying aware of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends

- Occasionally helping identify new editing styles or content formats that could work for Unsighted

- Training and guidance will be provided. We're much more interested in your editing ability, creativity, instincts, and willingness to learn than having a number of years of experience.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS:

- Creative and genuinely passionate about video editing

- Has a strong understanding of short-form content

- Has excellent pacing and storytelling instincts

- Understands what makes people stop scrolling

- Comfortable working with fast-paced, sometimes chaotic footage

- Familiar with internet culture, memes, trends, and social media

- Reliable and able to meet tight deadlines

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Comfortable receiving feedback and making quick changes

- Proactive and able to suggest creative ideas

- Able to work independently

- Able to capture Unsighted's personality through editing

- Comfortable working with large amounts of raw footage

- Interested in growing with a long-term creative team



REQUIRED

- Willingness to edit in CapCut 

- Reliable equipment setup for handling large media files

- high speed internet to upload and download files quickly



BONUS — NOT REQUIRED

Experience editing TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts

Experience working with creators or influencers

Experience working in Capcut, and/or using Capcut Teams (this is big bonus!!)

Experience in other softwares: Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Adobe, or similar editing software

Familiarity with Unsighted's content or White Girl Dance



WORK SCHEDULE



Approximately 40 hours per week

Fully remote

Flexible but consistent availability required

Overlap with Unsighted's schedule will be required

Ability to turn around edits within agreed timelines is important

Hours will increase as the brand and content volume grow

Content is typically posted between 12 PM–5 PM ET, so priority edits may need to be completed and ready for review before scheduled posting times

The role is expected to produce approximately 6–8 short-form edits per working day



COMPENSATION



$3 USD per hour (approx 40hr/week)



Approximately $240 USD bi-weekly



Paid bi-weekly.



There is potential for hour to increase as the role grows over time. Performance bonuses and raises are possible for reliable long-term editors who consistently deliver strong work and take on additional responsibility. 



WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE



You won't just be editing random videos for a faceless company. You'll be working directly with Unsighted, a rapidly growing creator and public figure whose content reaches millions of people around the world.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



- A short introduction about yourself

- Your previous editing experience, if any

- What editing software you use

- Your internet speed and equipment details

- Your availability (hours per day / timezone) [we will need to post daily 12pm est to 5pm est]

- A link to your editing portfolio or previous work

- 2–3 examples of short-form videos you've edited

- Your relationship with social media (Do you use TikTok/Instagram often? Do you follow editing trends?)

- Optional: Your Instagram/TikTok handle because we'd love to get a sense of your personality, communication style, and understanding of social media!



Please include the subject line:



"Unsighted Video Editor Application"
